What is Calm?

Calm is the #1 mental health app designed to help you manage stress, sleep better, and live a
happier, healthier life. Our research-based tools help you build life-changing habits to support
your mental health. If you're having trouble falling asleep, our 500+ [Sleep Stories][3]®,
soundscapes, and guided [sleep meditations][4] can lull you to sleep. If you're spiraling in
negative thoughts and need immediate relief, our 60-second Breathe Bubble grounds you in the moment
and helps your body return to a state of relaxation. If you're overwhelmed at work and need a
breather, our [stress and burnout specialists][5] can guide you through exercises to help calm your
mind. We're here for you whenever or wherever you need us with more content and tools being added
monthly.

What's included in a Calm subscription?

A Calm subscription unlocks our full library of [meditations][6], [Sleep Stories][7], [music][8],
and other features. The subscription includes:
* Multiple original [daily offerings][9] from a range of teachers to give your day a dose of wisdom,
  gratitude and encouragement
* Hours of [guided meditations][10] covering sleep, anxiety, stress, gratitude, and much more
* Our entire library of more than 500+ [Sleep Stories][11], with new stories added every week
* Exclusive [music][12] tracks for focus, relaxation, and sleep

Where should I get started once I download the app?

If you have come to Calm to learn relaxation techniques and improve aspects of your mental health,
we recommend beginning with the [7 Days of Calm][13], our introductory program that offers the
basics of meditation, and then move on to the [21 Days of Calm][14]. With that foundation, you can
explore our library of sessions and programs, which address themes such as [anxiety][15],
[sleep][16], [focus][17], and [gratitude][18]. Additionally, for moments of acute stress or anxiety,
we offer in-the-moment calming exercises via our [Panic SOS][19], [Body Scan][20], and breathing
exercise features.

If you have come to Calm to improve your sleep, we have a collection of over 500 [Sleep Stories][21]
to help you drift off to restful sleep, ranging from [classic literature][22] to [nature
essays][23], [children's tales][24], scientific articles, and more. We update our Sleep Stories
selection with new options to listen to every week. We also have a collection of soothing Sleep
Music.

What devices support the Calm app?

Calm is available on iOS, Android, Web, in addition to Apple TV, Apple Watch, Google WearOS, and
Samsung Health.

3. Tap 'Manage Subscription' and follow the instructions here to cancel your subscription.

How do I cancel?

To cancel your Calm subscription:
1. Tap 'Profile' on your app's Home screen.
2. Tap the 'Settings' gear icon in the top left corner of your screen.
3. Tap 'Manage Subscription' and follow the instructions here to cancel your subscription.
4. For subscriptions purchased through Apple and Google Play, tap the word 'here' on your Manage
   Subscription page to be redirected to your device's subscription settings.

### MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS

What is meditation?

Meditation is the practice of allowing thoughts to come and go, as you learn to recognize and
release them without judgment. Studies show that a long-term meditation practice can actually help
shift your nervous system out of fight or flight and into the relaxed parasympathetic mode producing
a wide array of benefits* including:
* Decreased anxiety and depression symptoms
* Chronic pain management
* Lower stress levels
* Improved sleep quality

What is mindfulness?

Mindfulness is a practice that involves intentionally bringing one's attention and awareness to the
present moment without judgment. It's about being fully present and engaged in the here and now,
rather than dwelling on the past or worrying about the future. Mindfulness encourages a
non-judgmental attitude towards one's thoughts, emotions and sensations, allowing them to arise and
pass without any added stress. By cultivating mindfulness, people often develop a greater sense of
clarity, calmness and overall wellbeing, as well as enhance their ability to respond skillfully to
the challenges of life.

### STRESS & ANXIETY

What causes stress and anxiety?

Stress and anxiety can have various causes and can differ greatly from person to person. Here are a
few common factors that contribute to stress and anxiety:
1. Major life changes: Significant life events such as moving, getting married (or divorced),
   starting a new job or experiencing the loss of a loved one can trigger it.
2. Work or school pressure: High workloads, tight deadlines, challenging bosses, or work pressure
   can lead to stress and anxiety.
3. Financial challenges: Job loss, debt, or just struggling to make ends meet can be a significant
   source of stress and anxiety.
4. Relationships: Whether romantic, familial or social, strain or conflict in relationships can
   cause stress and anxiety.
5. Health concerns: Managing chronic illness, physical pain or battling a health condition can be a
   cause, as well.
6. Traumatic experiences: Experiencing a traumatic event, such as an accident, abuse or even a
   natural disaster can lead to anxiety-related conditions.
7. Uncertainty and change: Experiencing frequent change (even positive change!) or feeling uncertain
   about the future can be a common cause of anxiety.

It's important to note that not everyone experiences stress and anxiety in the same way. If you're
dealing with stress and anxiety, it's recommended to seek support from a mental health professional
who can provide personalized guidance.

How can I manage my stress and anxiety?

Once you're in the Calm app, we recommend using a Breathing Bubble exercise if you're looking for
immediate stress or anxiety relief. Breathwork elicits the body's relaxation response which reduces
tension and lowers stress.

We also have other content programs, including our [Overcome Stress and Anxiety][25] collection in
partnership with clinical psychologist, Dr. Julie Smith. In this series, Dr. Julie guides listeners
through high stress moments in real time, including panic attacks, negative thought spirals, and
more.

In addition to Dr. Julie's series, you can find more guided breathing exercises and meditations in
our [Reduce Stress & Anxiety][26] collection. Let experts such as [Jay Shetty][27], [Tamara
Levitt][28], and [Chibs Okereke][29] help guide you into peaceful mindfulness and relaxation.

### SLEEP

Why do I have trouble sleeping?

There can be various reasons why you may be experiencing trouble sleeping. Here are a few common
factors that can contribute to sleep difficulties:
1. Stress and Anxiety: High levels of stress or anxiety can make it difficult to relax and fall
   asleep. Racing thoughts, worry, or an overactive mind can keep you awake at night.
2. Poor Sleep Habits: Irregular sleep patterns, inconsistent bedtime routines, excessive caffeine or
   alcohol consumption, and engaging in stimulating activities before bed can disrupt your sleep.
3. Environmental Factors: Uncomfortable sleeping environment, excessive noise, extreme temperatures,
   or inadequate lighting can interfere with your ability to fall asleep or stay asleep.
4. Medical Conditions: Certain medical conditions, such as chronic pain, sleep apnea, restless leg
   syndrome, or hormonal imbalances, can disrupt your sleep.
5. Mental Health Issues: Depression, bipolar disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and
   other mental health disorders can affect sleep patterns and quality.

If you're consistently having trouble sleeping, it's advisable to consult with a healthcare
professional who can help assess your specific situation and provide guidance that's tailored to
your needs.

How can I sleep better naturally?

In the Calm app, we recommend starting with our Fall Asleep collection, which features our most
popular [Sleep Stories][30]®, [soundscapes][31], [music][32], and [meditations][33] based on your
goals:
* Help falling asleep: natural sleep aids
* Getting back to sleep: reactive tools used to soothe and lull you back to sleep
* Unwinding before bed: proactive tools to help start a sleep routine and focuses on sleep hygiene -
  this means focusing on building habits and an environment designed for optimal sleep

Our most popular sleep offering is our [Sleep Stories][34]®, which are bedtime stories designed to
help you drift off to sleep. Many of our narrators are also names you may already be familiar with,
from artists like [Harry Styles][35] and [Michael Bublé][36] to actors and actresses such as
[Jennifer Garner][37] and [Matthew McConaughey][38].

With over 500 Sleep Stories® in our library, we have a library fit for both adults and kids, making
our app something the whole family can enjoy. Kids can enjoy exclusive Sleep Stories® featuring
favorite characters such as [Peppa Pig][39], [Minions][40], [Winnie the Pooh][41],
[Transformers][42], and more.

In addition to Sleep Stories®, we also have soothing soundscapes and music that have been
sonically-engineered to help you sleep. Choose from nature sounds such as [rainstorms][43] and
[ocean waves][44], to different frequency pitches including [white][45], [brown][46], and
[green][47] noise. With over 500 different options and new offerings being added monthly, our Sleep
Sounds library has something for everyone—whether you're looking to relax, focus, or fall asleep.

If you're looking for something that provides a bit more guidance, Calm also offers a variety of
sleep meditations and breathwork. These exercises help lower the heart rate, which shifts your
nervous system out of fight or flight and into a relaxed parasympathetic mode, enabling your body to
fall into a deeper sleep.

Lastly, we also have a Sleep Check-In feature which offers a new way to track your sleep. Check in
with your nightly sleep quality, and we'll show you patterns to guide you towards better sleep
habits and health.

How do I cancel?

You can cancel your Calm subscription's auto-renewal or free trial at any time.

To cancel your Calm subscription:
1. Tap 'Profile' on your app's Home screen.
2. Tap the 'Settings' gear icon in the top left corner of your screen.
3. Tap 'Manage Subscription' and follow the instructions here to cancel your subscription.
4. For subscriptions purchased through Apple and Google Play, tap the word 'here' on your Manage
   Subscription page to be redirected to your device's subscription settings.

### MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS

What is meditation?

Meditation is the practice of allowing thoughts to come and go, as you learn to recognize and
release them without judgment. Studies show that a long-term meditation practice can actually help
shift your nervous system out of fight or flight and into the relaxed parasympathetic mode producing
a wide array of benefits* including:
* Decreased anxiety and depression symptoms
* Chronic pain management
* Lower stress levels
* Improved sleep quality

What is mindfulness?

Mindfulness is a practice that involves intentionally bringing one's attention and awareness to the
present moment without judgment. It's about being fully present and engaged in the here and now,
rather than dwelling on the past or worrying about the future. Mindfulness encourages a
non-judgmental attitude towards one's thoughts, emotions and sensations, allowing them to arise and
pass without any added stress. By cultivating mindfulness, people often develop a greater sense of
clarity, calmness and overall wellbeing, as well as enhance their ability to respond skillfully to
the challenges of life.

### STRESS & ANXIETY

What causes stress and anxiety?

Stress and anxiety can have various causes and can differ greatly from person to person. Here are a
few common factors that contribute to stress and anxiety:
1. Major life changes: Significant life events such as moving, getting married (or divorced),
   starting a new job or experiencing the loss of a loved one can trigger it.
2. Work or school pressure: High workloads, tight deadlines, challenging bosses, or work pressure
   can lead to stress and anxiety.
3. Financial challenges: Job loss, debt, or just struggling to make ends meet can be a significant
   source of stress and anxiety.
4. Relationships: Whether romantic, familial or social, strain or conflict in relationships can
   cause stress and anxiety.
5. Health concerns: Managing chronic illness, physical pain or battling a health condition can be a
   cause, as well.
6. Traumatic experiences: Experiencing a traumatic event, such as an accident, abuse or even a
   natural disaster can lead to anxiety-related conditions.
7. Uncertainty and change: Experiencing frequent change (even positive change!) or feeling uncertain
   about the future can be a common cause of anxiety.

It's important to note that not everyone experiences stress and anxiety in the same way. If you're
dealing with stress and anxiety, it's recommended to seek support from a mental health professional
who can provide personalized guidance.

How can I manage my stress and anxiety?

Once you're in the Calm app, we recommend using a Breathing Bubble exercise if you're looking for
immediate stress or anxiety relief. Breathwork elicits the body's relaxation response which reduces
tension and lowers stress.

We also have other content programs, including our [Overcome Stress and Anxiety][25] collection in
partnership with clinical psychologist, Dr. Julie Smith. In this series, Dr. Julie guides listeners
through high stress moments in real time, including panic attacks, negative thought spirals, and
more.

In addition to Dr. Julie's series, you can find more guided breathing exercises and meditations in
our [Reduce Stress & Anxiety][26] collection. Let experts such as [Jay Shetty][27], [Tamara
Levitt][28], and [Chibs Okereke][29] help guide you into peaceful mindfulness and relaxation.

### SLEEP

Why do I have trouble sleeping?

There can be various reasons why you may be experiencing trouble sleeping. Here are a few common
factors that can contribute to sleep difficulties:
1. Stress and Anxiety: High levels of stress or anxiety can make it difficult to relax and fall
   asleep. Racing thoughts, worry, or an overactive mind can keep you awake at night.
2. Poor Sleep Habits: Irregular sleep patterns, inconsistent bedtime routines, excessive caffeine or
   alcohol consumption, and engaging in stimulating activities before bed can disrupt your sleep.
3. Environmental Factors: Uncomfortable sleeping environment, excessive noise, extreme temperatures,
   or inadequate lighting can interfere with your ability to fall asleep or stay asleep.
4. Medical Conditions: Certain medical conditions, such as chronic pain, sleep apnea, restless leg
   syndrome, or hormonal imbalances, can disrupt your sleep.
5. Mental Health Issues: Depression, bipolar disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), and
   other mental health disorders can affect sleep patterns and quality.

If you're consistently having trouble sleeping, it's advisable to consult with a healthcare
professional who can help assess your specific situation and provide guidance that's tailored to
your needs.

How can I sleep better naturally?

In the Calm app, we recommend starting with our Fall Asleep collection, which features our most
popular [Sleep Stories][30]®, [soundscapes][31], [music][32], and [meditations][33] based on your
goals:
* Help falling asleep: natural sleep aids
* Getting back to sleep: reactive tools used to soothe and lull you back to sleep
* Unwinding before bed: proactive tools to help start a sleep routine and focuses on sleep hygiene -
  this means focusing on building habits and an environment designed for optimal sleep

Our most popular sleep offering is our [Sleep Stories][34]®, which are bedtime stories designed to
help you drift off to sleep. Many of our narrators are also names you may already be familiar with,
from artists like [Harry Styles][35] and [Michael Bublé][36] to actors and actresses such as
[Jennifer Garner][37] and [Matthew McConaughey][38].

With over 500 Sleep Stories® in our library, we have a library fit for both adults and kids, making
our app something the whole family can enjoy. Kids can enjoy exclusive Sleep Stories® featuring
favorite characters such as [Peppa Pig][39], [Minions][40], [Winnie the Pooh][41],
[Transformers][42], and more.

In addition to Sleep Stories®, we also have soothing soundscapes and music that have been
sonically-engineered to help you sleep. Choose from nature sounds such as [rainstorms][43] and
[ocean waves][44], to different frequency pitches including [white][45], [brown][46], and
[green][47] noise. With over 500 different options and new offerings being added monthly, our Sleep
Sounds library has something for everyone—whether you're looking to relax, focus, or fall asleep.

If you're looking for something that provides a bit more guidance, Calm also offers a variety of
sleep meditations and breathwork. These exercises help lower the heart rate, which shifts your
nervous system out of fight or flight and into a relaxed parasympathetic mode, enabling your body to
fall into a deeper sleep.

Lastly, we also have a Sleep Check-In feature which offers a new way to track your sleep. Check in
with your nightly sleep quality, and we'll show you patterns to guide you towards better sleep
habits and health.

## Frequently asked questions
* What is Headspace?
  
  Headspace is your lifelong guide to better mental health. Through evidence-based [meditation][108]
  and [mindfulness tools][109], [sleep resources][110], [mental health coaching][111], and more,
  Headspace helps you create life-changing habits to support your mental health and find a
  healthier, happier you.
* What is Headspace’s mission?
  
  Headspace was founded in 2010 with the mission to revolutionize mental health for humanity and to
  guide you to more joy, less stress, and the best sleep of your life. A better day at work, home,
  and all the moments in between — Headspace makes it easy for you to love your mind.
* How do I download the Headspace app?
  
  The Headspace app is currently available on Apple (iPhone, iPad, iPod Touch) and Android
  (smartphone and tablet) devices. [Sign up for a Headspace account][112], and then you'll be
  directed to download the app to get started.
* What is included in a Headspace app subscription?
  
  Once you've [subscribed][113], your subscription will include:
  * [1,000+ expert-led exercises][114]: Mood-boosting meditations and stress-relieving tools for all
    of life’s moments
  * Find your best sleep: Rest easy with [relaxing wind downs][115], [soundscapes][116], and
    fan-favorite [sleepcasts][117]
  * [Proven mental health resources][118]: Reach your goals with tools backed by research and
    delivered by trained mindfulness experts
  
  You can also add [mental health coaching][119] to your plan.
  
  If you need help choosing a plan or subscribing, please visit our [FAQs][120].
* How much does Headspace cost?
  
  You can check out all of our different [subscription plans][121], which include our [Annual][122]
  and [Monthly][123] plans. We also have [student][124] and [family plans][125], as well as a
  [gift][126] option.
* Does my Headspace subscription automatically renew?
  
  Yes, your [annual][127] or [monthly][128] subscription will auto-renew. Unless canceled, monthly
  subscriptions automatically renew each month and annual subscriptions automatically renew each
  year on the day you subscribed. Your subscription can be canceled at any time.
* How do I cancel my Headspace subscription?
  
  If you need help canceling your subscription, you can learn more [here][129].
* How can I support my team’s mental health at work?
  
  [Request a demo][130] to learn more about how we help you support your team. Headspace is here to
  provide mindfulness, coaching, [EAP][131], therapy, psychiatry, and more to 4,000+ organizations
  worldwide.

## Questions? Answers.

Find quick tips and helpful info about The Mindfulness App and starting your new mindfulness
journey.

Still have questions? Dive deeper in our help center!

[Visit help center][18]

### What is The Mindfulness App?

The Mindfulness App is a comprehensive meditation and wellness platform offering guided meditations,
structured courses, sleep stories, and calming soundscapes — designed to help you build a
sustainable mindfulness practice in just a few minutes a day.

### Is The Mindfulness App good for beginners?

Absolutely. We start you off with a **5-day “Beginner’s Journey”** that teaches the basics
step-by-step. As you progress, you can explore hundreds of sessions for intermediate and advanced
users, so the app grows with your practice.

### Which languages does The Mindfulness App support?

The Mindfulness App’s interface and guided-audio library are fully localised in **English, Swedish,
Norwegian, Danish, German, Spanish, Finnish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Portuguese and
Chinese**.

We’re actively producing new sessions in these and additional languages — check the **Discover › New
& Noteworthy** shelf for fresh drops on a weekly basis.

### Does The Mindfulness App work offline?

Yes. Tap the **Download** icon on any meditation, course, or Sleep Story. Downloads land in your
**Library** under the **Downloads** tab, for easy on-the-go listening without Wi-Fi or data usage.

Your downloads remain available as long as you keep them; there’s **no hard limit**. However, keep
in mind that large libraries will use more storage.

### Does The Mindfulness App offer a free trial?

Yes, every new user receives a **14-day free trial** with full premium access to our content library
of over +500 guided meditations, sleep stories, courses and much more.

You can claim your free trial by [clicking here][19]. and following the checkout steps. Cancel
anytime during the trial, no questions asked.

### What does The Mindfulness App include in a subscription plan?

Your premium subscription unlocks the entire content library — over +500 guided meditations,
immersive sleep stories, themed courses on stress, focus, sleep and resilience, and nature
soundscapes, as well as personalised reminders with streak tracking.

All this seamlessly accessible across iOS, Android and the web — so you have everything you need for
a consistent, flexible mindfulness practice.

## Sign up today and try 14 days for free

Get full access to our premium library with **over +500** meditations, sleep stories and courses for
free!

[Try for free][20]
Start your journey to a more relaxed and healthier state of mind. Whether you are just starting out
or experienced in meditation, we will help you to become more present in your daily life.

# [breathe][9]

## [View Hacking: Shifting Your View of Other People][10]

#### By [Leo Babauta][11]

Let’s imagine a scenario where you are standing in front of everyone, at your own party, surrounded
by friends and family … but you’re afraid of their judgments.

You’re afraid one family member thinks you’re wasting your life, another might think you’re lazy,
another might think you don’t have nice enough clothes, another might think you’re not in good
enough shape. You don’t know that they have these judgments, but you’re afraid they might.

Stressful right? This is why people get social anxiety — we never know what people might be
thinking, how they might be judging us.

I’m going to share something that we’ll call “view hacking” — basically, changing our view of other
people, so that we can have a very different experience, way less stressful.

Let’s dive in.

### **Why We Stress About Other People**

In the scenario I mentioned, what makes it stressful to be in front of all these people you know?

It’s the fear that they’re judging you. The fear of letting others down, of not fitting in, of being
rejected. We don’t know if they’re judging us, but we’re afraid that they are.

So the view that we have is something like: these people are judging me.

It’s possible that’s true, but think about viewing the situation as a minefield for possible
judgment and embarrassment — stressful, right?

The stress comes from this view.

The view that the people might be judging us, that we might be embarrassed, that the whole situation
is dangerous … that’s the view that causes stress.

When we’re frustrated by other people, anxious about them, or having other kinds of problems like
that … the stress comes from the view that we have of them. You might journal about it to try to
uncover the view you have that’s stressing you out. It’s powerful.

### **Shift the View**

Once we’ve identified the view, what can we do about it?

Well, first we should acknowledge that nothing needs to be done. It’s OK to be stressed about,
frustrated by, anxious about other people.

But if we’d like to be less stressed about them, we can shift the view. Come up with a new view that
feels more empowering and less stressful.

Some examples:
* These people love and support me
* I’m grateful to have a connection with this person
* They’re trying their best, and have beautiful hearts
* It would be fun to play with this person!
* If they get upset, it’s a chance for a deeper connection with them

These are just a few examples — can you find a new view that would make you feel less stressed about
people?

Once you have the view, it’s time to practice: write it down, and remind yourself of the new view
whenever you’re feeling that stress. Let yourself really feel the new view, as if it were absolute
truth. And then relate to this person or these people in this new way.

It takes a while to shift the view. But if you are intentional about it, the shift can be profound.

## Effortless Meditation.
## 
## Sustainable Living.

### ***If times are urgent, let us slow down. ***

**BAYO AKOMOLAFE**

## True wellness is disruption.

While wellness is often translated as “self care,” true wellness is disrupting the idea that we are
separate from the needs and realities of each other. It is also an interruption in the patterns and
systems that keep us distracted, overwhelmed and disconnected from our own wisdom. When things fall
apart, how do we find a felt sense of safety and stability? How do we practice possibility and care
for one another while external conditions are rapidly shifting? 

### ***I believe we hold the possibility to be of service and impact others. That should not come at
### the cost of our own health and nervous system.***

Meditation is a top-down approach, meaning we are using the mind under the function of the cerebral
cortex. Top down processes like meditation, pranayama or talk therapy can help to create capacity,
perspective and clarity with overall thinking and being. While it has a correlating effect on the
body, there are also bottom-up approaches as well to help metabolize the effects of chronic stress
and trauma. Working somatically is utilizing the language of the body to release contractions or
patterned responses. One is not necessarily better than the other. In fact, by utilizing both top
down as well as bottom up approaches, we are giving the body and mind an equal place in an
integrative and holistic process of healing.



### *My mission is to deepen the ways in which we relate to ourselves as well as each other. 
### *

### *I look forward to working with you.*

### About Alchemy Collective

I began Alchemy Collective 10 years ago with the intent of fostering a community for individuals
looking to create change in themselves as well as the world around them. My interests and strengths
lie at the intersection of meditation, somatics, and social change to help others alchemize stress
into expansion, knowledge into action and wellness into collective care.

### About Mark

I am a student of sustainability, decolonization, somatics, and Vedantic philosophy. With decades of
lived experience as an artist, teacher and coach, I know what grind culture and hustle can do to a
nervous system but also have keen insight into the psychology of high performance, creativity and
innovation. Work demands and personal loss left me with PTSD a number of years back which led to
initial studies into Vedic meditation. From there I saw the challenge/opportunity to support
traditional instruction with a practice of embodiment as well as tools for collective care. This was
the catalyst for a decade long journey of inquiry and training to be of service to others and to
foster sustainability in practice.

## *Accountability*

As a cis-white male of privilege, I am committed to disrupting patterns and systems of dominant
culture to bring about more just and equitable chages. To practice collective care starts with
unpacking one's relationship with power and privilege, one’s relationship to self, which is a
lifetime of work. Because I believe in sustainability, 25% of profits from all meditation teaching
is directed towards land regeneration organizations in India and portions of somatic work are
dedicated to supporting organizations dedicated to mental health awareness. And whether facilitating
meditation, somatics or coaching, all courses are taught through the lens of being trauma-informed,
which means you are always in choice and agency throughout the sessions.

## *Current Offerings*
* Trauma Informed Meditation
  
  Investing 3% of our day into a practice of meditation can help build capacity, adaptability, as
  well as lower the effects of chronic stress. Vedic meditation is an effortless and natural top
  down approach. It’s ancient knowledge designed for modern living, delivered in 4 modules in
  addition to an Intro session and ongoing follow up support upon completion of the course.
  
  [**Learn More **➔][28]
* Somatic Healing

  simple practices to release contractions and patterning within the body and restore a felt sense
  of authenticity and embodiment.
  
  [**Learn more ➔**][29]
* Corporate Workshops & 1 on 1 Coaching
  
  Innovation, performance, better sleep and immunity are just a few of the reasons to invest in
  sustainability training for your team. Whether it be working individually, with CEO’s, and/or with
  teams, having an understanding of what stress is, how it reduces relationships, as well concrete
  tools can help redefine sustainability in high demand work environments.
  
  [**Learn more** ➔][30]

## Sign up to receive event updates

First Name
Last Name
Email Address
Join the community

*We respect your privacy.*

Thank you for connecting. I look forward to being in community with you!

*Here’s what people are saying…*
* ## "A game changing encounter in my life."
  
  “Incredible depth, care for others and superb combination of IQ and EQ. Mark has and will continue
  to impact thousands (hopefully millions) of lives. A game changing encounter in my life.”
  
  ***Darleen, global Human Resources executive***
* ## "This practice was a lifesaver for me"
  
  Working with Mark has changed my life. I first started working with Mark when I was in crisis,
  dealing with an extended family emergency. Mark taught me how to meditate using the Vedic mantra
  method of meditating twice a day for 20 minutes. This practice was a lifesaver for me and enabled
  me to navigate through that stressful time and maintain a robust self care practice that I still
  use 6 years later. Moreover, Mark’s somatic healing sessions have helped me to use these
  techniques to interrupt negative thought patterns and calm down my nervous system.”
  
  ***Sarah, artist***
* ## "It’s easy to stay disciplined when you’re seeing results."
  
  Being a person in long-term recovery, the importance of stilling my mind and shedding self cannot
  be overstated. Over the course of my journey, I’ve been to the doctor; I’ve drank from the
  fountains. Then I met Mark and discovered what I believe to have been the missing piece. In just
  one month of practice, I have noticed an observable improvement in my stress responses and my
  sleep. It’s easy to stay disciplined when you’re seeing results.
  
  ***Richie, Attorney***
* ## "Ideas pop into my head in a much clearer way"
  
  Meditation has enabled me to hold many tasks at once with far less stress or anxiety than before.
  Ideas pop into my head in a much clearer way and I retain them... which is AMAZING! This practice
  has really been a game changer for me!
  
  ***Stephanie, nutrition coach***
* ## "One of the best investments I have ever made."
  
  Having tried meditation apps, 20-day challenges, etc. I felt like I was missing something and was
  left feeling frustrated. Mark made meditation accessible, which is exactly what it should be—easy,
  stress-free, and something you enjoy. This meditation course with Alchemy Collective is one of the
  best investments I have ever made.
  
  ***Chris, actor and fitness trainer***

lived experience as an artist, teacher and coach, I know what grind culture and hustle can do to a
nervous system but also have keen insight into the psychology of high performance, creativity and
innovation. Work demands and personal loss left me with PTSD a number of years back which led to
initial studies into Vedic meditation. From there I saw the challenge/opportunity to support
traditional instruction with a practice of embodiment as well as tools for collective care. This was
the catalyst for a decade long journey of inquiry and training to be of service to others and to
foster sustainability in practice.

## *Accountability*

As a cis-white male of privilege, I am committed to disrupting patterns and systems of dominant
culture to bring about more just and equitable chages. To practice collective care starts with
unpacking one's relationship with power and privilege, one’s relationship to self, which is a
lifetime of work. Because I believe in sustainability, 25% of profits from all meditation teaching
is directed towards land regeneration organizations in India and portions of somatic work are
dedicated to supporting organizations dedicated to mental health awareness. And whether facilitating
meditation, somatics or coaching, all courses are taught through the lens of being trauma-informed,
which means you are always in choice and agency throughout the sessions.

## *Current Offerings*
* Trauma Informed Meditation
  
  Investing 3% of our day into a practice of meditation can help build capacity, adaptability, as
  well as lower the effects of chronic stress. Vedic meditation is an effortless and natural top
  down approach. It’s ancient knowledge designed for modern living, delivered in 4 modules in
  addition to an Intro session and ongoing follow up support upon completion of the course.
  
  [**Learn More **➔][28]
* Somatic Healing
  
  Somatics is a bottom up approach to healing, helping to re-establish pathways of ease, expansion
  and safety within the body. Whether it’s a personalized 1 on 1 program or group course, they are
  simple practices to release contractions and patterning within the body and restore a felt sense
  of authenticity and embodiment.
  
  [**Learn more ➔**][29]
* Corporate Workshops & 1 on 1 Coaching
  
  Innovation, performance, better sleep and immunity are just a few of the reasons to invest in
  sustainability training for your team. Whether it be working individually, with CEO’s, and/or with
  teams, having an understanding of what stress is, how it reduces relationships, as well concrete
  tools can help redefine sustainability in high demand work environments.
  
  [**Learn more** ➔][30]

* ### [Ananda Marga][108]
  
  Ananda Marga is a global spiritual and social service organization founded in 1955 by [Shrii Shrii
  Anandamurti][109] (Prabhat Ranjan Sarkar). The mission of Ananda Marga is self-realization
  (individual emancipation) and service to humanity (collective welfare): the fulfillment of the
  physical, mental and spiritual needs of all people. Through its meditation centers and service
  projects around the world, Ananda Marga offers instruction in meditation, yoga and other
  self-development practices on a non-commercial basis, and responds to social emergencies and
  long-term social needs. [Read more…][110]
* ### [Self-Realization, Service to All][111]
  
  The ideology of Ananda Marga is Self-Realization and Service to All.
  
  Both aspects are complementary to each other, and both are necessary for a balanced and fulfilling
  life.
  
  The welfare of each and everyone is linked to the welfare of society, and the welfare of society
  depends on the welfare of each and everyone.
  
  [Self-Realization][112]
  
  [Service to All][113]
* ### [Learn Meditation Today][114]
  
  Ananda Marga teaches meditation free of charge all around the world.
  
  Visit our [learn meditation][115] page to learn meditation today!
  
  [[poster]][116]
* ### Ananda Nagar film and photo book
  
  The documentary film [*Ananda Nagar: Land of Bliss*][117] is an overview of the history of Ananda
  Nagar, the pioneering multipurpose rural development scheme and spiritual eco-village of Ananda
  Marga in Rarh, India.
  
  The [photo book][118] *Ananda Nagar: Land of Bliss *is the definitive record of Ananda Nagar,
   tracing its past, present and future. Also available as an [ebook here][119].
* ### Shrii Shrii Anandamurti Centenary
  
  The celebrations for the 100th anniversary of the birth of Shrii Shrii Anandamurti, the guru of
  Ananda Marga, included a documentary film, [exhibition][120] and two [photo books][121], also
  available as [ebooks here][122].

* ### [Ananda Marga][108]
  
  Ananda Marga is a global spiritual and social service organization founded in 1955 by [Shrii Shrii
  Anandamurti][109] (Prabhat Ranjan Sarkar). The mission of Ananda Marga is self-realization
  (individual emancipation) and service to humanity (collective welfare): the fulfillment of the
  physical, mental and spiritual needs of all people. Through its meditation centers and service
  projects around the world, Ananda Marga offers instruction in meditation, yoga and other
  self-development practices on a non-commercial basis, and responds to social emergencies and
  long-term social needs. [Read more…][110]
* ### [Self-Realization, Service to All][111]
  
  The ideology of Ananda Marga is Self-Realization and Service to All.
  
  Both aspects are complementary to each other, and both are necessary for a balanced and fulfilling
  life.
  
  The welfare of each and everyone is linked to the welfare of society, and the welfare of society
  depends on the welfare of each and everyone.
  
  [Self-Realization][112]
  
  [Service to All][113]
* ### [Learn Meditation Today][114]
  
  Ananda Marga teaches meditation free of charge all around the world.
  
  Visit our [learn meditation][115] page to learn meditation today!
  
  [[poster]][116]
* ### Ananda Nagar film and photo book
  
  The documentary film [*Ananda Nagar: Land of Bliss*][117] is an overview of the history of Ananda
  Nagar, the pioneering multipurpose rural development scheme and spiritual eco-village of Ananda
  Marga in Rarh, India.
  
  The [photo book][118] *Ananda Nagar: Land of Bliss *is the definitive record of Ananda Nagar,
   tracing its past, present and future. Also available as an [ebook here][119].
* ### Shrii Shrii Anandamurti Centenary
  
  The celebrations for the 100th anniversary of the birth of Shrii Shrii Anandamurti, the guru of
  Ananda Marga, included a documentary film, [exhibition][120] and two [photo books][121], also
  available as [ebooks here][122].

## Sudarshan Kriya™

The cornerstone of Art of Living courses, the Sudarshan Kriya™ technique has helped millions around
the world to reduce [stress][288], to get better rest and to improve the quality of life.
Studies conducted on four continents and published in peer reviewed journals, including at Yale and
Harvard, have demonstrated a comprehensive range of benefits from reduction in cortisol, the stress
hormone, to increasing overall life satisfaction.

## Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar

Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar is a global humanitarian, spiritual leader and ambassador of peace.
Gurudev’s vision of personal and social transformation through mental health and wellness has
ignited a global movement in over 182 countries, uplifting the lives of more than 100 crore+ people.

## I want to join a program but...

the more relevant. In ancient times, meditation was used as a way for finding the Self, for
enlightenment. Meditation was a way to overcome misery and problems. It was the way to develop one’s
abilities.

If you take more responsibility, more meditation is required. Greater responsibilities and ambitions
you have, greater is the need for you to meditate.

## Sudarshan Kriya™

The cornerstone of Art of Living courses, the Sudarshan Kriya™ technique has helped millions around
the world to reduce [stress][288], to get better rest and to improve the quality of life.
Studies conducted on four continents and published in peer reviewed journals, including at Yale and
Harvard, have demonstrated a comprehensive range of benefits from reduction in cortisol, the stress
hormone, to increasing overall life satisfaction.

Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar is a global humanitarian, spiritual leader and ambassador of peace.

abilities.

## About Bayelsa Watch

**Bayelsa Watch** is a joint initiative built by two experienced teams focused on technology
research, business analysis, and digital innovation across Africa. The platform delivers clear and
verified insights on AI, Big Data, cybersecurity, startups, fintech, and emerging technologies
shaping Nigeria and the broader African market.

Our coverage combines global technology developments with local Nigerian and African business
trends, helping readers better understand how innovation is transforming industries, companies, and
everyday life across the region. Bayelsa Watch also reports on startup funding, company mergers,
investment activity, and financial performance updates with a strong focus on accuracy and
relevance.

Simple charts, statistics, and data-driven analysis are used to turn complex information into
practical insights that support smarter decisions for readers, entrepreneurs, and businesses
throughout Africa.

## About Bayelsa Watch

**Bayelsa Watch** is a joint initiative built by two experienced teams focused on technology
research, business analysis, and digital innovation across Africa. The platform delivers clear and
verified insights on AI, Big Data, cybersecurity, startups, fintech, and emerging technologies
shaping Nigeria and the broader African market.

Our coverage combines global technology developments with local Nigerian and African business
trends, helping readers better understand how innovation is transforming industries, companies, and
everyday life across the region. Bayelsa Watch also reports on startup funding, company mergers,
investment activity, and financial performance updates with a strong focus on accuracy and
relevance.

Simple charts, statistics, and data-driven analysis are used to turn complex information into
practical insights that support smarter decisions for readers, entrepreneurs, and businesses
throughout Africa.

# **OSHO INTERNATIONAL ONLINE **

## Individual Transformation for Contemporary People

### Live Online Courses and Individual Sessions

### Time to Turn up for Your Own Life

Find support on your journey of self-discovery at **OSHO International Online (OIO)**. Choose an
individual session or a group activity – a class, a course or a training – all live, online, and
guided by highly trained and experienced facilitators.

Based on Osho’s profound insights into the human condition, and his scientifically developed
methodologies and meditative techniques, your Osho Online experience will expand both your awareness
and your understanding. You will learn skills to help you to thrive in this new and ever-changing
world.

[][35]

## LIVE INDIVIDUAL SESSIONS

Based on Osho’s vision and his scientifically developed methodologies, OSHO International Online
offers a multitude of individual sessions relating to the body, the mind, the emotions, or the
subtle energy bodies.

[Discover you][36]
[][37]

## LIVE COURSE PREVIEWS

Join a 45-minute Free Course Preview and find out if a course or training is right for you. An
opportunity to experience the process and ask questions.

[Book Now][38]

## LIVE
## COURSES

OSHO International Online offers a range of live, transformative courses — all designed to provide a
bridge to meditation, and ultimately a bridge to oneself. The courses are based on many different
approaches, from Western psychology to contemporary meditative therapies.

[Pick Your Course][39]

## OSHO INTERNATIONAL ONLINE TRAININGS

### Includes a Certificate of Completion

OSHO International Online live trainings are designed for people who would like to learn to
facilitate the method they love, or who simply want to deepen their own experience.

[Learn More][43]
[][44]

## OSHO 1-to-1 PERSONAL ORIENTATION MEETING

## Individual Transformation for Contemporary People

### Live Online Courses and Individual Sessions

### Time to Turn up for Your Own Life

Find support on your journey of self-discovery at **OSHO International Online (OIO)**. Choose an
individual session or a group activity – a class, a course or a training – all live, online, and
guided by highly trained and experienced facilitators.

Based on Osho’s profound insights into the human condition, and his scientifically developed
methodologies and meditative techniques, your Osho Online experience will expand both your awareness
and your understanding. You will learn skills to help you to thrive in this new and ever-changing
world.

[][35]

## LIVE INDIVIDUAL SESSIONS

Based on Osho’s vision and his scientifically developed methodologies, OSHO International Online
offers a multitude of individual sessions relating to the body, the mind, the emotions, or the
subtle energy bodies.

[Discover you][36]
[][37]

## LIVE COURSE PREVIEWS

Join a 45-minute Free Course Preview and find out if a course or training is right for you. An
opportunity to experience the process and ask questions.

[Book Now][38]

## LIVE
## COURSES

Brahma Kumaris is a worldwide spiritual movement **led by women**, dedicated to personal
transformation and world renewal through **Rajyoga Meditation**. Founded in India in 1937, Brahma
Kumaris has **spread to over 110 countries** on all continents and has had an extensive impact in
many sectors as an international NGO.

**NEW! Buddhist Digital Resources**
This collection of Buddhist Digital Resources brings together a representative selection of Buddhist
electronic resources from all the traditions on the Internet. This will help to make the Buddha’s
teachings more accessible and a valuable research tool and guide for students and those interested
in the Buddha’s Dharma.
[bdr]
**BuddhaNet’s World Buddhist Directory**
Buddhist organisations are welcome to include/update their organisation’s information in the
database. If you wish to select one of the thousands of directory records to update, or to add a new
one, follow this link: [http://www.buddhanet.info/wbd/updateselect.php][131]
[wbd]
**Buddhist eLibrary Project**
Buddhist organisations are invited to provide digital content from their respective lineage or
teacher. This would benefit the worldwide Buddhist community and the dissemination of the Buddha
Dharma. Having your content on more than one server makes it more accessible in the case of a server
going down, even temporarily.

### The Museum allows visitors the unique
### experience to understand the artist Clyfford Still

Home to the art and legacy of the American painter Clyfford Still, we invite all to explore the
potential of individual creative endeavor. Designed specifically to display Clyfford Still’s art,
the award-winning Museum is home to nearly everything the artist created, approximately 3,125 pieces
representing 93% of his lifetime of work. The Museum supports new artistic endeavors, inviting
visitors to draw strength from Still’s art and life. Refresh, recharge, and reconnect with joy at
the Clyfford Still Museum.

At the Still, visitors will find a world-class collection gifted to the City and County of Denver,
award-winning architecture, cross-disciplinary events for all ages, and opportunities for visitors
to explore their own creativity. Exhibitions stimulate curiosity and explore multiple perspectives.
You are free to experience and understand the art on your own terms; there are no wrong answers at
the Still. Discover the best way to spend an hour in Denver at this unique art museum.

### The Museum allows visitors the unique
### experience to understand the artist Clyfford Still

Home to the art and legacy of the American painter Clyfford Still, we invite all to explore the
potential of individual creative endeavor. Designed specifically to display Clyfford Still’s art,
the award-winning Museum is home to nearly everything the artist created, approximately 3,125 pieces
representing 93% of his lifetime of work. The Museum supports new artistic endeavors, inviting
visitors to draw strength from Still’s art and life. Refresh, recharge, and reconnect with joy at
the Clyfford Still Museum.

At the Still, visitors will find a world-class collection gifted to the City and County of Denver,
award-winning architecture, cross-disciplinary events for all ages, and opportunities for visitors
to explore their own creativity. Exhibitions stimulate curiosity and explore multiple perspectives.
You are free to experience and understand the art on your own terms; there are no wrong answers at
the Still. Discover the best way to spend an hour in Denver at this unique art museum.

## About Us, Our Advantages

As a leading cushion manufacturer, we are committed to creating high-quality cushions that bring
comfort and fashion to your home. From material selection to production process, we are committed to
providing excellent products to enhance your living space.

With high-quality, innovative design, and customer satisfaction as our core advantages, we are
committed to providing durable and comfortable seat cushions to meet customers’ personalized needs
through innovative design and customization options.

 

## Cushion Material Introduce

### Cotton Cloth

The Cushion made of cotton fabric is soft, comfortable, and has good breathability, providing a
gentle sitting sensation.

### Linen

Cushion natural fiber made of linen material has good moisture absorption and breathability,
maintaining a cool feeling.

### Foam

Foam cushions are lightweight, affordable, and offer good support. They retain their shape well and
provide comfort.

## Frequently Asked Question!

What materials are used in your cushion production?

We use a variety of high-quality materials in our cushion production, including premium foam, memory
foam, down, feathers, and synthetic fibers. Each material is carefully selected to ensure
durability, comfort, and support.

How do you ensure the quality of your cushions?

We have strict quality control processes in place throughout our production. Our experienced team
follows rigorous standards to ensure that each cushion meets our high-quality criteria. We conduct
thorough inspections and tests to guarantee durability, comfort, and longevity.

Are your cushions customizable in terms of size and shape?

Yes, we offer customization options for our cushions. You can choose from a range of sizes and
shapes to meet your specific requirements and preferences. Our goal is to provide tailored solutions

### Cotton Cloth

The Cushion made of cotton fabric is soft, comfortable, and has good breathability, providing a
gentle sitting sensation.

### Linen

Cushion natural fiber made of linen material has good moisture absorption and breathability,
maintaining a cool feeling.

### Foam

Foam cushions are lightweight, affordable, and offer good support. They retain their shape well and
provide comfort.

## Frequently Asked Question!

What materials are used in your cushion production?

We use a variety of high-quality materials in our cushion production, including premium foam, memory
foam, down, feathers, and synthetic fibers. Each material is carefully selected to ensure
durability, comfort, and support.

How do you ensure the quality of your cushions?

We have strict quality control processes in place throughout our production. Our experienced team

thorough inspections and tests to guarantee durability, comfort, and longevity.

Are your cushions customizable in terms of size and shape?

Yes, we offer customization options for our cushions. You can choose from a range of sizes and

Are your cushions easy to clean and maintain?

## Welcome

[Vipassana][157], which means to see things as they really are, is one of India's most ancient
techniques of meditation. It was taught in India more than 2500 years ago as a universal remedy for
universal ills, i.e., an [Art of Living][158]. For those who are not familiar with Vipassana
Meditation, an Introduction to Vipassana by Mr. Goenka & related videos and [Questions &
Answers][159] about Vipassana are available.

### Courses

The technique of Vipassana Meditation is taught at ten-day residential courses during which
participants learn the basics of the method, and practice sufficiently to experience its beneficial
results. There are no charges for the courses - not even to cover the cost of food and
accommodation. All expenses are met by donations from people who, having completed a course and
experienced the benefits of Vipassana, wish to give others the opportunity to also benefit.

## Welcome

[Vipassana][157], which means to see things as they really are, is one of India's most ancient
techniques of meditation. It was taught in India more than 2500 years ago as a universal remedy for
universal ills, i.e., an [Art of Living][158]. For those who are not familiar with Vipassana
Meditation, an Introduction to Vipassana by Mr. Goenka & related videos and [Questions &
Answers][159] about Vipassana are available.

### Courses

The technique of Vipassana Meditation is taught at ten-day residential courses during which
participants learn the basics of the method, and practice sufficiently to experience its beneficial
results. There are no charges for the courses - not even to cover the cost of food and
accommodation. All expenses are met by donations from people who, having completed a course and
experienced the benefits of Vipassana, wish to give others the opportunity to also benefit.

### Locations

Courses are given in numerous Meditation Centers and at Non-Center course locations at rented sites.
Each location has its own schedule of courses. In most cases, an application for admission to these
courses can be completed online at this website. There are many Vipassana Centers throughout the
world in [India][160] and elsewhere in [Asia/Pacific][161], in [North America][162], in [Latin
America][163], in [Europe][164], in [Australia/New Zealand][165], in the [Middle East][166] and in
[Africa][167]. Ten day non-center courses are frequently held at many locations outside of Centers
as they are arranged by local students of Vipassana in those areas. An [alphabetical list][168] of
worldwide course locations is available as well as a graphical interface of course locations
[worldwide][169] and in [India and Nepal][170].

### Special Courses and Resources

Vipassana Meditation courses are also being taught in [prisons][171]. A special 10-day Vipassana
course especially for business executives and government officials is being held periodically at
several centers around the world. For additional information visit the [Executive Course
Website][172]. Information on Vipassana Meditation is also available in the other languages. Click
on the globe on the top right of the page to select a language.

## Welcome

[Vipassana][157], which means to see things as they really are, is one of India's most ancient
techniques of meditation. It was taught in India more than 2500 years ago as a universal remedy for
universal ills, i.e., an [Art of Living][158]. For those who are not familiar with Vipassana
Meditation, an Introduction to Vipassana by Mr. Goenka & related videos and [Questions &
Answers][159] about Vipassana are available.

### Courses

The technique of Vipassana Meditation is taught at ten-day residential courses during which
participants learn the basics of the method, and practice sufficiently to experience its beneficial
results. There are no charges for the courses - not even to cover the cost of food and
accommodation. All expenses are met by donations from people who, having completed a course and
experienced the benefits of Vipassana, wish to give others the opportunity to also benefit.

### Locations

Courses are given in numerous Meditation Centers and at Non-Center course locations at rented sites.
Each location has its own schedule of courses. In most cases, an application for admission to these
courses can be completed online at this website. There are many Vipassana Centers throughout the
world in [India][160] and elsewhere in [Asia/Pacific][161], in [North America][162], in [Latin
America][163], in [Europe][164], in [Australia/New Zealand][165], in the [Middle East][166] and in
[Africa][167]. Ten day non-center courses are frequently held at many locations outside of Centers
as they are arranged by local students of Vipassana in those areas. An [alphabetical list][168] of
worldwide course locations is available as well as a graphical interface of course locations
[worldwide][169] and in [India and Nepal][170].

### Special Courses and Resources

Vipassana Meditation courses are also being taught in [prisons][171]. A special 10-day Vipassana
course especially for business executives and government officials is being held periodically at
several centers around the world. For additional information visit the [Executive Course
Website][172]. Information on Vipassana Meditation is also available in the other languages. Click
on the globe on the top right of the page to select a language.

## ABOUT DHARMACRAFTS

Discover inspiration for your meditation practice and everyday life. Since 1979, the Buddhist and
mindfulness meditation community has relied on DharmaCrafts for quality meditation supplies. We make
it easy to create a tranquil meditation room in your home with our exclusive line of handcrafted
meditation cushions that are handmade in Massachusetts, USA.

Our cushion selection includes buckwheat zafu pillows, zabuton mats, bolster pillows, and support
cushions in a variety of colors and fabrics - including organic cotton. Create your very own
meditation space with our Buddhist statues, inspirational home decor, authentic tatami mats, altar
tables, incense offerings, spiritual jewelry, yoga gear, wellness supplies, meditation cushions for
children, and more.

## ABOUT DHARMACRAFTS

mindfulness meditation community has relied on DharmaCrafts for quality meditation supplies. We make
it easy to create a tranquil meditation room in your home with our exclusive line of handcrafted
meditation cushions that are handmade in Massachusetts, USA.

Our cushion selection includes buckwheat zafu pillows, zabuton mats, bolster pillows, and support
cushions in a variety of colors and fabrics - including organic cotton. Create your very own
meditation space with our Buddhist statues, inspirational home decor, authentic tatami mats, altar
tables, incense offerings, spiritual jewelry, yoga gear, wellness supplies, meditation cushions for
children, and more.

About this pause

## A two-minute pause for your nervous system

Do Nothing for 2 Minutes is a simple mindfulness timer for the moments when your mind feels crowded.
No account, no app, no feed, no instructions to optimize yourself. Just ocean waves, a quiet timer,
and two minutes where nothing needs to happen.

Use it between meetings, before starting focused work, after scrolling too long, or whenever you
notice your body asking for a reset. The practice is intentionally small: sit still, breathe
naturally, and let your hands leave the keyboard and mouse alone.

If you move, the timer starts again. Not as punishment, but as a gentle reminder that rest works
best when it is actually uninterrupted.

Two minutes will not solve everything. But it can create a little space before the next thing.

[ Learn More ][51]
[Athlete in black attire meditating alone on a black mat, focusing on mindfulness and physical
well-being.]

### Athletes

Picture this: You're not just in the game, you're thriving under high pressure moments. Our athlete
meditation sessions are your go-to for sharpening focus and mastering emotions. Feel the difference
as you step up, not just as a winner, but as a true champion.

[ Learn More ][52]
[Young girl in classroom meditating with classmates, promoting mindfulness and student well-being.]

### Students

Our classroom mindful meditation workshops will bring a greater sense of calm to your students. When
your classroom is calmer and your students are more balanced, they will listen more and remain
focused for longer. This in turn will lead to greater success academically and a more harmonious
academic journey for both the student and teacher.

[ Learn More ][53]
[Young person warmly embracing elderly person with hands intertwined symbolizing care and connection
across generations]

### Aged Care

Our meditation workshops are designed to bring peace and joy to aged care residents. We focus on
gentle, practical, and accessible practices that help reduce stress, improve mental clarity, and
promote a sense of community. It's the perfect way to improve the well-being of your residents and
brighten their days.

[ Learn More ][54]
[close up on female hands meditating in the lotus position]

### Private Coaching

Ever feel like you need a meditation session designed just for you? That's exactly what our private
meditation classes offer. Our private classes are carefully tailored to meet your needs and find
that style of meditation that is best aligned with your personal journey. We will help pave your
individual path to inner calm and clarity.

[ Learn More ][55]

## Meditation Benefits

[Lotus flower icon symbolising mindfulness and spiritual growth.]

### Reduces Stress and Anxiety

[Light bulb icon representing innovation and creative ideas]

### Enhances Problem Solving Abilities

[Eye icon symbolising vision, focus, and observation]

### Improves Focus and Concentration

[Icon of a person sleeping, representing restfulness and relaxation]

### Improves Sleep Quality

[Tick icon symbolising approval, completion, and success.]

### Strengthens the Immune System

[Icon of a key unlocking a mind, representing self-discovery, mental freedom, and unlocking
potential]

### Unlocks Self Awareness

Here’s What Our Meditation Students Have to Say
* ## "I've been meditating with Alex for 2.5 years and can't imagine life without these sessions.
  ## His expert guidance has helped me grow as a meditator and human being. Looking forward to more
  ## rewarding experiences. Thank you, Enso, for making me a more complete person."
  
  -Susanne Hellier
* ## "Through Enso I have been taught many different things about meditating that I never knew
  ## existed. Along with providing us with a variety of meditations, Enso promotes kindness,
  ## self-love, and a sense of community. I look forward to their sessions daily. Very grateful for
  ## this opportunity."
  
  -Tami Morgan
* ## "Enso's meditations are for everyone, whether you have tried meditating or not. No need to
  ## fear, you won't be put in a trance. No special techniques or knowledge needed. Alex has a
  ## soothing voice, each meditation is different."
  
  -Ruth Roberts

[ Read More ][56]
[Image of classroom of children meditating together representing peace and serenity in the
classroom]

## Explore More

Meditation: The Classroom Game Changer for Students

Explore the impact of meditation in classrooms with our latest blog. Discover how it enhances
student focus, empathy, and well-being, and learn how Enso's meditation sessions can transform the
educational experience for students and teachers alike.

[ Read More ][57]
[busy office hand writing report wearing suit]

The ROI of Corporate Meditation

In today's fast-paced corporate world, the quest for peak performance and employee well-being is
more critical than ever. Companies are investing in various wellness programs, but one practice
that's gaining momentum is corporate meditation…

Get into the right headspace with just the right music. From internationally-acclaimed artists such

Let the sound of water, waves, and wind wash all your worries away.  Listen to the birds sing or

Build sessions from 4- and 8-minute meditations that are easy to fit into your day-to-day life.

###### Welcome to FLOW WELLNESS CENTRE

# Inner calm. Real connection. Practical wellbeing — for you and your team.

At Flow Wellness Centre, we offer holistic care for mind, body and energy — supporting individuals
and teams to reconnect with balance, presence and resilience.

Whether you’re looking for emotional healing, a place to breathe, or a practical path to wellness at
work…
You’re in the right place.

## Where would you like to begin?

Discover the perfect program for your needs

## I’m here for myself

Gentle, intuitive support to help you feel more grounded, clear and energised.

## I’m a mum looking for support

Emotional support and practical knowledge for the journey of motherhood.

## I’m looking to support my team

Professional wellbeing programs that reduce stress and boost resilience in the workplace.

## Not sure where to start?

Let’s chat. I’d love to hear your story and help you find the right support.

[ Book a free discovery call ][35]
[Meditation in Tallebudgera]

## Meet Fab – The Heart Behind Flow Wellness

With over two decades of experience in nursing, holistic therapies and meditation, Fab brings a
calm, compassionate presence to everyone she works with. Her own journey through healing and
transformation is what inspires the work we do at Flow Wellness Centre today.

Discover her story and the vision behind Flow.

[ ABOUT US ][36]

## What she offers

### Holistic Therapy (Reiki + Energy Work)

A restorative experience for body, mind and energy.
**Feel**
You’ve been feeling off — energetically, emotionally or physically.
You might not be able to name it, but you know something is out of balance. This is a space to feel
held, heard and realigned.
**Flow**
Each session is tailored to what you need that day — drawing from Reiki, grounding practices,
intuitive healing, emotional release and calming nervous system techniques.
You’ll lie down fully clothed and simply receive.
**Grow**
Most clients leave feeling lighter, clearer and reconnected with themselves.
It’s more than just “feeling better” — it’s about restoring your inner flow so that your body, mind
and energy can work in harmony again.

[ BOOK A SESSION ][37]

### Group Meditation (weekly sessions)

For those who need a moment to exhale — and don’t want to do it alone.
**Feel**
You’re tired of rushing. You’re craving presence, but it’s hard to slow down by yourself.
You want space to breathe, reflect, and reconnect — gently and without pressure.
**Flow**
These sessions offer a calm, welcoming space.
We begin with a short reflection, then I’ll guide you through a gentle meditation (no silence or
awkwardness). We often finish with tea, journaling, or light conversation. Get connected with
like-minded people.
No experience needed — just come as you are.
**Grow**
Leave feeling lighter, clearer, and more grounded.
You’ll build emotional resilience, inner calm, and real connection — both with yourself and the
group.
This isn’t just meditation. It’s a reset for your nervous system and your week.

[ BOOK A SESSION ][38]

### Corporate Wellness Programs

Stress-reduction and performance support for modern teams.

**Mindful Reset Session™**
A 30-minute experience to shift mindset, release pressure, and spark clarity.

**The Resilient Mind Method™**
A 10-week evidence-informed program that supports calm focus, emotional regulation, and better
decision-making.

[ VIEW PROGRAM ][39]

### Spiritual/ Holistic Mentoring for Mums

You hold everything together — this is space for someone to hold you.
**Intention**
To support you emotionally, mentally and spiritually in the real experience of motherhood — beyond
the to-do list.
You don’t need to be fixed. You just need a space to be seen, supported and reminded of your
strength.
**Journey**
Each session is tailored to your needs: we explore emotional burnout, the invisible load, identity
shifts, self-compassion, nervous system regulation and more.
This isn’t coaching or therapy — it’s grounded support for your heart, body and mind.
**The Shift**
You’ll feel more

Professional wellbeing programs that reduce stress and boost resilience in the workplace.

## Meet Fab – The Heart Behind Flow Wellness

calm, compassionate presence to everyone she works with. Her own journey through healing and
transformation is what inspires the work we do at Flow Wellness Centre today.

Discover her story and the vision behind Flow.

[ ABOUT US ][36]

## What she offers

### Holistic Therapy (Reiki + Energy Work)

A restorative experience for body, mind and energy.
**Feel**
You’ve been feeling off — energetically, emotionally or physically.
You might not be able to name it, but you know something is out of balance. This is a space to feel
held, heard and realigned.
**Flow**
Each session is tailored to what you need that day — drawing from Reiki, grounding practices,
intuitive healing, emotional release and calming nervous system techniques.
You’ll lie down fully clothed and simply receive.
**Grow**
Most clients leave feeling lighter, clearer and reconnected with themselves.
It’s more than just “feeling better” — it’s about restoring your inner flow so that your body, mind
and energy can work in harmony again.

[ BOOK A SESSION ][37]

### Group Meditation (weekly sessions)

For those who need a moment to exhale — and don’t want to do it alone.
**Feel**
You’re tired of rushing. You’re craving presence, but it’s hard to slow down by yourself.
You want space to breathe, reflect, and reconnect — gently and without pressure.
**Flow**
These sessions offer a calm, welcoming space.
We begin with a short reflection, then I’ll guide you through a gentle meditation (no silence or
awkwardness). We often finish with tea, journaling, or light conversation. Get connected with
like-minded people.
No experience needed — just come as you are.
**Grow**
Leave feeling lighter, clearer, and more grounded.
You’ll build emotional resilience, inner calm, and real connection — both with yourself and the
group.
This isn’t just meditation. It’s a reset for your nervous system and your week.

[ BOOK A SESSION ][38]

### Corporate Wellness Programs

Stress-reduction and performance support for modern teams.

**Mindful Reset Session™**
A 30-minute experience to shift mindset, release pressure, and spark clarity.

**The Resilient Mind Method™**
A 10-week evidence-informed program that supports calm focus, emotional regulation, and better
decision-making.

[ VIEW PROGRAM ][39]

### Spiritual/ Holistic Mentoring for Mums

You hold everything together — this is space for someone to hold you.
**Intention**
To support you emotionally, mentally and spiritually in the real experience of motherhood — beyond
the to-do list.
You don’t need to be fixed. You just need a space to be seen, supported and reminded of your
strength.
**Journey**
Each session is tailored to your needs: we explore emotional burnout, the invisible load, identity
shifts, self-compassion, nervous system regulation and more.
This isn’t coaching or therapy — it’s grounded support for your heart, body and mind.

# Meditation und Achtsamkeit mit Hannes Huber

 

 

**Vipassana Retreats 2025/26** siehe [hier][5]

**Metta Retreat 2026** siehe [hier][6]

 

 


 

 

 

 

Als ich jung war, las ich viele Bücher über Entdecker und war sehr enttäuscht, dass keine
unentdeckten Plätze mehr übrig waren.

Seitdem ich die psychologische Welt entdeckt habe, weiß ich, dass das eine Welt der Wildnis ist, die
schon von vielen erforscht wurde. Viele aber kehren in unsere Welt zurück, ohne richtige Instrumente
mitzubringen und gehen verloren.

Ich habe das beste Instrument - Achtsamkeit.

  *Sayadaw U Jotika*

 

 

Den Dingen geht der Geist voran, der Geist entscheidet: Kommt aus getrübtem Geist dein Wort und
deine Taten, so folgt dir Leiden - wie dem Zugtier folgt der Wagen.

Den Dingen geht der Geist voran, der Geist entscheidet: Entspringem klarem Geist dein Wort und deine
Taten, folgt das Glück dir nach - wie auf Schritt und Tritt dein Schatten.

[ **Hannes Huber** ][3]

Liebe/r InteressentIn,

Um auf dem Laufenden zu bleiben, bitte ich dich momentan öfters auf meine Homepage zu schauen - oder
dich  über [Kontakt][4] für den Newsletter einzutragen.

 

# Meditation und Achtsamkeit mit Hannes Huber

 

 

**Vipassana Retreats 2025/26** siehe [hier][5]

**Metta Retreat 2026** siehe [hier][6]

 

 


 

 

 

 

Als ich jung war, las ich viele Bücher über Entdecker und war sehr enttäuscht, dass keine
unentdeckten Plätze mehr übrig waren.

Seitdem ich die psychologische Welt entdeckt habe, weiß ich, dass das eine Welt der Wildnis ist, die
schon von vielen erforscht wurde. Viele aber kehren in unsere Welt zurück, ohne richtige Instrumente
mitzubringen und gehen verloren.

Ich habe das beste Instrument - Achtsamkeit.

  *Sayadaw U Jotika*

 

 

Den Dingen geht der Geist voran, der Geist entscheidet: Kommt aus getrübtem Geist dein Wort und
deine Taten, so folgt dir Leiden - wie dem Zugtier folgt der Wagen.

Den Dingen geht der Geist voran, der Geist entscheidet: Entspringem klarem Geist dein Wort und deine
Taten, folgt das Glück dir nach - wie auf Schritt und Tritt dein Schatten.

*Dhammapada*

## [Sai Baba iš Širdžio (1838-1918). Biografija][48]


Sai Nath arba Sai Baba iš Širdžio mažai žinomas Vakaruose, tačiau apie jį žino praktiškai visa
Indija. Kalba eina apie didingą Indijos šventąjį, stebukladarį ir dvasinį mokytoją, gyvenusį daugiau
nei prieš šimtą metų Maharaštroje, kuris padėjo pamatus indų ir musulmonų vienovei Šiaurės ir
Centrinėje Indijoje.

Sai Nath buvo tikras Dvasinis Mokytojas (Guru), tai yra Sad Guru. Jo didingumo neišeina aprašyti.
Jeigu kažkas ateidavo pas jį į daršaną, tai jis galėjo be jokių prašymų atverti tam žmogui jo
praeitį, dabartį ir ateitį. Jis matė Dievą visose būtybėse. Su draugais ir priešais jis elgėsi
vienodai. Nei sėkmė, nei nemalonumai neišvesdavo jo iš pusiausvyros. Jis iš nieko nelaukė dėkingumo
ir laimino visus. Jis neturėjo nei abejonių, nei baimių.… [skaityti daugiau][49]

shot during a yoga tour to the sacred places in Tibet.

*With new birth in oblivion, in silence
The memory of eternal soul is erased.
Why do I incarnate in another life?
And who is the one walking next to me?*

*The thread of karma is tangled, hidden from view.
Perhaps we’ve been here together before.
And once again on the sacred path
We walk the eternal kora again.*

We recommend watching the film in 4K format.

Join our next trip: [https://en.oum.ru/tours/world/tibet-yoga-tour/][54]

## [Sai Baba iš Širdžio (1838-1918). Biografija][48]


Sai Nath arba Sai Baba iš Širdžio mažai žinomas Vakaruose, tačiau apie jį žino praktiškai visa
Indija. Kalba eina apie didingą Indijos šventąjį, stebukladarį ir dvasinį mokytoją, gyvenusį daugiau
nei prieš šimtą metų Maharaštroje, kuris padėjo pamatus indų ir musulmonų vienovei Šiaurės ir
Centrinėje Indijoje.

Sai Nath buvo tikras Dvasinis Mokytojas (Guru), tai yra Sad Guru. Jo didingumo neišeina aprašyti.
Jeigu kažkas ateidavo pas jį į daršaną, tai jis galėjo be jokių prašymų atverti tam žmogui jo
praeitį, dabartį ir ateitį. Jis matė Dievą visose būtybėse. Su draugais ir priešais jis elgėsi
vienodai. Nei sėkmė, nei nemalonumai neišvesdavo jo iš pusiausvyros. Jis iš nieko nelaukė dėkingumo
ir laimino visus. Jis neturėjo nei abejonių, nei baimių.… [skaityti daugiau][49]

We are happy to announce a new film by [oum.ru][53] yoga club “Kailash. Path from life to life”,
shot during a yoga tour to the sacred places in Tibet.

*With new birth in oblivion, in silence
The memory of eternal soul is erased.
Why do I incarnate in another life?
And who is the one walking next to me?*

*The thread of karma is tangled, hidden from view.
Perhaps we’ve been here together before.
And once again on the sacred path
We walk the eternal kora again.*

We recommend watching the film in 4K format.

Join our next trip: [https://en.oum.ru/tours/world/tibet-yoga-tour/][54]

## In It for the Long Run

[[Person using fartlek techique while running in a park]][38]
[Exercise & Fitness][39]

##### [What Is Fartlek Training?][40]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/fartlek-run

fitness and keep your routine from getting ... too routine

[[Person looking over a new running shoe in a store]][41]
[Exercise & Fitness][42]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/how-to-pick-the-running-shoe-that-is-best-for-you

[[Person walking dog and person running in a park, with person sitting on a bench]][44]
[Exercise & Fitness][45]

to 5 feet 7 inches around the world

[[Woman doing a yoga stretch in their living room]][59]
[Exercise & Fitness][60]

##### [Does Stretching Make You Taller?][61]

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/does-stretching-make-you-taller

https://health.clevelandclinic.org/what-is-the-average-height-for-a-man
