## Frequently asked questions

Didn't find the answer to your question?

[Read all FAQs][35]
What product will enable me to have an out-of-body experience?

An OBE cannot be guaranteed. Your ability to experience an OBE depends on many factors unique to
every individual, like personal beliefs, possible fear barriers, etc. If you are interested in an
OBE, we recommend Hemi-Sync® Support for Journeys Out of the Body or the Gateway Experience series.

What’s the difference between Human Plus®, Mind Food®, Heart-Sync® and Metamusic®?

Human Plus recordings teach you how to activate the benefit of a particular selection whenever you
wish without listening at the particular moment when you desire the intended effect. For example,
the Human Plus title, Attention, exercise teaches you how to move into a highly focused state when
not listening to the Attention exercise. Most Mind Food and Heart-Sync titles provide the
experience/benefit while you are listening. For example, the Mind Food title, Concentration, helps
your brain move into a highly focused state of concentration while listening. Metamusic® selections
contain music and Hemi-Sync® with no verbal guidance.

Is there a problem in making copies of Hemi-Sync® products for friends?

Yes. Hemi-Sync® products are copyrighted. You would be breaking federal laws and therefore be liable
to prosecution.

Is Hemi-Sync® recommended for children?

All nonverbal recordings are fine for children. With verbally guided titles, we recommend you listen
first and then decide based on your child’s level of maturity.

Are the Hemi-Sync® frequencies the same on each title?

No. The Hemi-Sync® process has evolved into a sophisticated multi-layering of Hemi-Sync® signals –
“designer mixes” of sound frequencies, fashioned to be optimally effective for a given application.
Naturally, Hemi-Sync® sleep products incorporate predominately delta frequencies; learning products
predominately beta and so forth. However these designer mixes are supplemented with special sound
frequencies, which enable the desired result. This is the “key” to the effectiveness of Hemi-Sync.

## Frequently asked questions

Didn't find the answer to your question?

[Read all FAQs][35]
What product will enable me to have an out-of-body experience?

An OBE cannot be guaranteed. Your ability to experience an OBE depends on many factors unique to
every individual, like personal beliefs, possible fear barriers, etc. If you are interested in an
OBE, we recommend Hemi-Sync® Support for Journeys Out of the Body or the Gateway Experience series.

What’s the difference between Human Plus®, Mind Food®, Heart-Sync® and Metamusic®?

Human Plus recordings teach you how to activate the benefit of a particular selection whenever you
wish without listening at the particular moment when you desire the intended effect. For example,
the Human Plus title, Attention, exercise teaches you how to move into a highly focused state when
not listening to the Attention exercise. Most Mind Food and Heart-Sync titles provide the
experience/benefit while you are listening. For example, the Mind Food title, Concentration, helps
your brain move into a highly focused state of concentration while listening. Metamusic® selections
contain music and Hemi-Sync® with no verbal guidance.

Is there a problem in making copies of Hemi-Sync® products for friends?

Yes. Hemi-Sync® products are copyrighted. You would be breaking federal laws and therefore be liable
to prosecution.

Is Hemi-Sync® recommended for children?

All nonverbal recordings are fine for children. With verbally guided titles, we recommend you listen
first and then decide based on your child’s level of maturity.

Are the Hemi-Sync® frequencies the same on each title?

No. The Hemi-Sync® process has evolved into a sophisticated multi-layering of Hemi-Sync® signals –
“designer mixes” of sound frequencies, fashioned to be optimally effective for a given application.
Naturally, Hemi-Sync® sleep products incorporate predominately delta frequencies; learning products
predominately beta and so forth. However these designer mixes are supplemented with special sound
frequencies, which enable the desired result. This is the “key” to the effectiveness of Hemi-Sync.

## Hluru Musical Instrument

Hluru, is a leading manufacturer of healing and meditation musical instruments. Specializing in
steel tongue drums, kalimbas, handpans, and lyras, Hluru is dedicated to crafting instruments that
resonate with the soul. Our steel tongue drums, renowned for their ethereal and soothing tones, are
particularly popular among those seeking mindfulness,tranquility, and healing .
 

Hluru's steel tongue drums offer a pure and calming sound, perfect formeditation, yoga, and
therapeutic practices . Our kalimbas, crafted from premium wood, produce a clear and bright tone
that is loved by musicians worldwide. Discover inner peace and embracehealing vibrationswith Hluru
instruments.

Journey helps organizations recognize emerging mental health risks before they escalate. Signals

before employees reach a breaking point.

Powered by Journey Signal™ AI intelligence engine, these insights trigger timely digital and human
outreach so employees receive the right support at the right moment.

engaged through personalized content and proactive outreach that help employees build resilience and
healthier habits over time.

Seamless integrations with tools like Teams, Slack, Zoom, email, and calendars — along with
Breakroom Apps and Journey Tablets for deskless employees — ensure support reaches the entire
workforce and fits naturally into daily routines, making it easier to participate before stress
becomes overwhelming.

## Sign up to Katherine’s Mystical Monday newsletter

Off-the-cuff musings on psychedelics, death, motherhood, and ethics, plus occasional news about
writing and speaking events. Arriving in your inbox unexpectedly and synchronistically, but always
on a Monday.

First Name

# TALKS

### **OPEN WIDE AND SAY AWE**

"On April 15, 2012, I was flying home from a conference. And on the first leg of my trip, somewhere
between Tucson and Las Vegas, I died." Join Katherine as she explores the wild and magical terrain
of death, psychedelics and healing, from the clinic at Johns Hopkins to her sister's hospital room
and beyond.

### BEFRIENDING THE MYSTERY

Psychedelics have officially re-entered mainstream consciousness, through clinical research trials
at major universities, corporate-sponsored pharmaceutical drug development, and decriminalization
efforts in major America cities. Everyone from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to Michael Pollan now has a
story to tell about how mushrooms can save humanity. But let's not forget the original love stories
that the mushrooms have been quietly sharing with humans for millennia. In this talk, Dr. Katherine
MacLean weaves a tale of scientific discovery, mystical love, super-natural intelligence, and
personal redemption from the perspective of individual humans and their amazing encounters with
psilocybin mushrooms.

### THE PSYCHEDELIC ART OF DYING

You only have a few days left to live. How would you want to live? How would you want to die?

# TALKS

### **OPEN WIDE AND SAY AWE**

"On April 15, 2012, I was flying home from a conference. And on the first leg of my trip, somewhere
between Tucson and Las Vegas, I died." Join Katherine as she explores the wild and magical terrain
of death, psychedelics and healing, from the clinic at Johns Hopkins to her sister's hospital room
and beyond.

### BEFRIENDING THE MYSTERY

Psychedelics have officially re-entered mainstream consciousness, through clinical research trials
at major universities, corporate-sponsored pharmaceutical drug development, and decriminalization
efforts in major America cities. Everyone from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to Michael Pollan now has a
story to tell about how mushrooms can save humanity. But let's not forget the original love stories
that the mushrooms have been quietly sharing with humans for millennia. In this talk, Dr. Katherine
MacLean weaves a tale of scientific discovery, mystical love, super-natural intelligence, and
personal redemption from the perspective of individual humans and their amazing encounters with
psilocybin mushrooms.

You only have a few days left to live. How would you want to live? How would you want to die?

## Hi, I'm Giovanni

[giovanni name in brush]

## Hi, I'm

[giovanni name in brush]

I’m an author, certified meditation teacher, coach and speaker. With over 9,000 hours of meditation,
and a diverse training in different traditions, my teaching style is pragmatic, simple, methodical,
and non-sectarian.

My personal anthem—and the transformation I facilitate—is **Empowered Peace**. This is the reality I
live in now.

But I was *not* born peaceful. As a teenager I was restless. My mind was always busy, and never
content. I was easily disturbed, and would often overreact when triggered. I also struggled with
being bullied.

Things started to change when I found meditation—and all its wisdom teachings—as a 15-year old.
Meditation taught me that the real bully is inside my head, and that I can learn to be my own best
friend. It taught me how to let go, be greater than my problems, and accept myself.

LiveAndDare exists so that you too can be **calm, centered, focused** — and experience empowered
peace.

This is my purpose. Will you join me?

## Hi, I'm Giovanni

[giovanni name in brush]

## Hi, I'm

[giovanni name in brush]

I’m an author, certified meditation teacher, coach and speaker. With over 9,000 hours of meditation,
and a diverse training in different traditions, my teaching style is pragmatic, simple, methodical,
and non-sectarian.

My personal anthem—and the transformation I facilitate—is **Empowered Peace**. This is the reality I
live in now.

But I was *not* born peaceful. As a teenager I was restless. My mind was always busy, and never
content. I was easily disturbed, and would often overreact when triggered. I also struggled with
being bullied.

Things started to change when I found meditation—and all its wisdom teachings—as a 15-year old.
Meditation taught me that the real bully is inside my head, and that I can learn to be my own best
friend. It taught me how to let go, be greater than my problems, and accept myself.

LiveAndDare exists so that you too can be **calm, centered, focused** — and experience empowered
peace.

This is my purpose. Will you join me?

### Lucis Trust

*Lucis* is a form of the Latin word, lux, and means ‘*Light*’

The Lucis Trust is dedicated to the establishment of a new and better way of life for everyone in
the world based on the fulfillment of the divine plan for humanity. Its educational activities
promote recognition and practice of the spiritual principles and values upon which a stable and
interdependent world society may be based. The esoteric philosophy of its founder, Alice Bailey,
informs its activities which are offered freely throughout the world in eight languages.

* ## Let the Plan of Love and Light work out

### Lucis Trust

*Lucis* is a form of the Latin word, lux, and means ‘*Light*’

The Lucis Trust is dedicated to the establishment of a new and better way of life for everyone in
the world based on the fulfillment of the divine plan for humanity. Its educational activities
promote recognition and practice of the spiritual principles and values upon which a stable and
interdependent world society may be based. The esoteric philosophy of its founder, Alice Bailey,
informs its activities which are offered freely throughout the world in eight languages.

How quickly can we implement Mantra for our organization?

Implementation typically takes 2-4 weeks depending on your organization size. We provide dedicated
support for setup, employee onboarding, and training. Most companies see active usage within the
first week of launch.

What is the cost structure for Mantra's services?

Our pricing is based on the number of employees and services selected. We offer flexible plans
starting from ₹500 per employee per month, with significant discounts for larger organizations and
annual commitments. Contact us for a customized quote.

How do you ensure data privacy and security?

We follow international standards including ISO 27001, HIPAA compliance, and GDPR protocols. All
data is encrypted in transit and at rest, stored in secure cloud infrastructure with regular
security audits and compliance checks.

Can Mantra integrate with our existing HR systems?

Yes, we offer seamless integration with popular HR systems like SAP SuccessFactors, Workday,
BambooHR, and others. Our API-first approach allows custom integrations with proprietary systems as
well.

What kind of support do you provide after implementation?

We provide 24/7 technical support, dedicated customer success managers, regular health reports, and
continuous optimization of your wellness programs based on usage analytics and employee feedback.

How do you measure the success of wellness programs?

We track multiple metrics including employee engagement rates, health outcome improvements,
reduction in sick days, healthcare cost savings, and ROI analysis. You’ll receive monthly reports
with actionable insights.

Is the platform available in regional Indian languages?

Yes, Mantra supports 12 major Indian languages including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi,
Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, and Assamese, in addition to English.

What happens if employees need emergency medical assistance?

Our platform includes 24/7 emergency helpline, coordination with local emergency services, and
immediate notification to designated company contacts. We also provide real-time location sharing
for emergency responders.

[Girl in black crop long sleave wearing sunglasses in front of the ocean chiming a meditation bell]

#### Individuals seeking…

**Coaching and hypnosis** sessions that allow you to move forward from the past, break limiting
beliefs, and effectively establish new habits (mental and behavioral) with confidence!

[LET’S CHAT][24]

[woman teaching a yoga class on the beach wearing sunglasses and a headset]

#### Corporations seeking…

**Wellness classes, workplace programs, or guided sessions at meetings and conferences.** I help
organizations integrate mindfulness in a way that enhances performance, reduces stress, and improves
company culture.

[LEARN MORE][25]

[Yoga instructor teaching tree pose on the beach]

#### Retreats, Events, and studios seeking…

**Keynote speaking, guest teaching, special workshops, or a retreat host**. I bring a grounded,
creative approach to every class and gathering, blending tradition with real-world practicality to
create experiences that are accessible, meaningful, and deeply nourishing.

[LETS COLLABORATE][26]

*Hey there!*

*I'm Sharon Cleere (*pronounced "clear"). For nearly 10 years, I've had the incredible privilege of
guiding meditation and teaching yoga to individuals and corporations across the country.*

self-help common in today’s culture and instead focusing on pragmatic techniques backed by modern
neuroscience and research. *

With my guidance and support, you'll embark on a peaceful journey of self-discovery and growth that
will leave you feeling liberated.

Let’s cultivate balance, align mind and body, and unlock the limitless possibilities that come with
true harmony.

# Learning Meditation

### Introduction to Meditation

Meditation is the art of looking inside and discovering one’s own inner being. Meditation leads us
not only to totally new inner experiences, but helps us also to transform our day-to-day life into a
better, more meaningful and more fulfilling existence.
* [What is Meditation?][19]

 

### Meditation Exercises

Meditation is something we experience ourself. Reading about meditation is not sufficient, we need
to practise and learn the art of meditation. This site offers a few simple meditation and
concentration exercises.
* [Meditation exercises][20]

 

### Benefits of Meditation

There is increasing interest in the various benefits of meditation. Many studies have shown regular
meditation can help alleviate symptoms of stress and aid physical health. Meditation can also give
many other benefits.
* [Benefits of Meditation][21]

 

### Questions about Meditation

Some Questions and Answers about Meditation. Including tips on how to silence the mind and overcome
common difficulties.
* [Questions and Answers][22]

 

### Learn To Meditate

Some of the practical guidelines for learning meditation and making it part of your daily practise.
Also information about Sri Chinmoy Centres who offer free meditation classes in different parts of
the world.
* [Learn to Meditate][23]

 

### Meditation Blog

Some articles and tips on meditation.
* [Meditation Blog][24]

 

### Meditation Teachers

There are many different paths of meditation. The goal of meditation is the same, but, there are
different ways to realise the goal of meditation. These are a small selection of the many Spiritual
teachers who have taught methods of meditation:
* [Meditation teachers][25]

**Corporate**

Prabhmeet offers right-mindfulness and meditation workshops tailored to meet the unique needs of
businesses across various sectors, helping teams reduce stress, enhance focus, and cultivate a
culture of wellbeing.

Working with Global companies, Prabhmeet has delivered workshops and talks ranging from a group of 6
people to 1,800 people. Audience members have spanned from  the UK, North Amercia, European
countries, Singapore and Australia.

**Personal**

Prabhmeet provides 1-2-1 psycho-spiritual therapy sessions, where he works together with you to
explore your personal challenges and unlock your full potential. As a Certified Coach, Prabhmeet
brings a holistic approach that combines goal-setting with emotional growth, ensuring that your
personal and professional development aligns with your inner values and purpose.

For those looking to deepen their practice, Prabhmeet runs an 8-week Mindfulness-Based Stress
Reduction (MBSR) course. This structured program is designed to reduce stress, increase resilience,
and foster a deeper sense of mindfulness and presence in daily life. Offered in Groups of up to six
people therefore allowing the power of ‘sangat’ or socialising ideas to drive individual change.

Whether you’re looking to enhance individual or team performance, improve wellbeing, or navigate
personal challenges, Prabhmeet can help you build a more mindful, focused, and resilient way of
living.

* Master’s in Transpersonal Psychology with a focus on Mindfulness Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT)
  and Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction (MBSR)
* Certified Professional

## Health Begins In The Mind

### Never had conversations this deep

I felt guided through the sessions and the routes of conversation we were taking. Each direction
taken was explained clearly and easy to understand.

Sandy

### Loved speaking with you

Spent a sessions discovering my ‘why?’ to get to the root cause of a problem rather than just
addressing a solution. Using this method really helped guide an understanding of how I think and
behave.

Lucy

### Thank you

I learnt that I give too much importance to external validation. Prabhmeet was able to show me this
but also show me how I can take control and keep trying me best.

Francis

### Where did you get your knowledge from!

I am very satisfied with my coaching experience as it has unlocked knowledge about myself that I
would not have been able to gain on my own.

Cynthia

### Thank you for bringing self-awareness

As a Senior Manager it was great to understand the subject of Promotion from a different angle and
point of view. You have been able to personalise the matter to my needs while managing to approach
the topic in an unbiased way.

Salmaan

### Appreciate the insights on my management style

Prabhmeet provided great workshop. He helped me develop my understanding of my potential management
style which will benefit me in a leadership role.

James

### You’ve helped me to understand perspective

Prabhmeet was able to help me demystify the way that I measure success, having a dim view of the
corporate world. He showed me the power of perspective and I feel a massivly uplifted through
further understanding myself.

Sheree

### Thank you!

Wanted to reach out and extend a big thank you from everyone who was lucky enough to attend out
‘Fireside chat’ with you yesterday. The engagement and interest from the room audience was
remarkable and the feedback has been incredibly positive!

Alison

### Feel uplifted

Thank you for the workshop at our office with the EMEA Mangement team. Many folks commented on how
they left the room feeling uplifted and hopeful – and many enlightened – they had truly learnt
something new that would add value to their lives.

Hugh

### Would love to continue the conversation!

It was both a priviledge and a treat to sit on the sofa with you, I especially enjoyed watching the
audience themsleves – after an initial surprise (it was a different type of conversation than we
have had before) they became totally engrossed in what you were saying! Would love to have you back
again to continue the conversation we have started!

James

### Lightbulb moments!

I spotted ‘light bulb’ moments going off here and there during the talk. So lovely for you to come
and host a session with us.

Samantha

### Thanks for the workshop

Thanks also for making the time after your workshop to speak to some audience members. I was able to
hover over and I could see you had given the time for those who were a little more shy to ask
questions on a 1-2-1 basis, very kind of you. Would welcome you back anytime for further sessions –
perhaps Mental Health Day in October?

Sara

**Corporate**

Prabhmeet offers right-mindfulness and meditation workshops tailored to meet the unique needs of
businesses across various sectors, helping teams reduce stress, enhance focus, and cultivate a
culture of wellbeing.

Working with Global companies, Prabhmeet has delivered workshops and talks ranging from a group of 6
people to 1,800 people. Audience members have spanned from  the UK, North Amercia, European
countries, Singapore and Australia.

**Personal**

Prabhmeet provides 1-2-1 psycho-spiritual therapy sessions, where he works together with you to
explore your personal challenges and unlock your full potential. As a Certified Coach, Prabhmeet
brings a holistic approach that combines goal-setting with emotional growth, ensuring that your
personal and professional development aligns with your inner values and purpose.

For those looking to deepen their practice, Prabhmeet runs an 8-week Mindfulness-Based Stress
Reduction (MBSR) course. This structured program is designed to reduce stress, increase resilience,
and foster a deeper sense of mindfulness and presence in daily life. Offered in Groups of up to six
people therefore allowing the power of ‘sangat’ or socialising ideas to drive individual change.

Whether you’re looking to enhance individual or team performance, improve wellbeing, or navigate
personal challenges, Prabhmeet can help you build a more mindful, focused, and resilient way of
living.

**Qualifications**
* Master’s in Transpersonal Psychology with a focus on Mindfulness Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT)
  and Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction (MBSR)
* Certified Professional

## OSHO INTERNATIONAL MEDITATION RESORT

Enjoy a tour of the world's most unique holiday destination. A resort based on meditation.
Reflecting the understanding that meditation is a quality you can bring to any activity.
It is not an activity in itself.

## [**OSHO** International Meditation Resort][201]

[ [Osho International Meditation Resort]][202]
[A Photo-tour][203] [More Information][204]

## MEDITATION

Discover how to bring the quality of meditation to every part of our everyday life.
Explore the many unique, active, and passive OSHO Meditations.
Each offers us an insight into different aspects of the meditative experience. We can then
incorporate these into our regular daily existence — transforming our lives in the process.

[ [Discover Osho Meditation]][205]
[Discover Osho Meditation][206]
[ [Why Active Meditation?]][207]
[Why Active Meditation?][208]

## BRIDGES TO MEDITATION

What is stopping us from enjoying our natural birthright of living with joy and playfulness?
Allowing ourselves to dive into the awareness that makes meditation transformative?
OSHO offers a wide range of courses and sessions directed at exactly this fundamental question.
How to let go of all those acquired self-limiting beliefs?
So we can then simply relax and discover our true meditative potential.
Both online and offline.

[ [OSHO International Online]][209]
[OSHO International Online][210]
[ [OSHO Multiversity]][211]
[OSHO Multiversity][212]

## OSHO INTERNATIONAL MEDIA

Osho is by far the most prolific non-fiction "author" in history. The result is hundreds of books,
and thousands of hours of talks, recorded and available on audio and video. They address every issue
that is central to the challenges each of us feels while confronting today's world. In addition,
Osho has created a vast range of meditation techniques to support our individual journeys - from
understanding the experience of those challenges to discovering how to transcend them.

## OSHO INTERNATIONAL MEDITATION RESORT

Enjoy a tour of the world's most unique holiday destination. A resort based on meditation.
Reflecting the understanding that meditation is a quality you can bring to any activity.
It is not an activity in itself.

## MEDITATION

Discover how to bring the quality of meditation to every part of our everyday life.
Explore the many unique, active, and passive OSHO Meditations.
Each offers us an insight into different aspects of the meditative experience. We can then
incorporate these into our regular daily existence — transforming our lives in the process.

## BRIDGES TO MEDITATION

What is stopping us from enjoying our natural birthright of living with joy and playfulness?
Allowing ourselves to dive into the awareness that makes meditation transformative?
OSHO offers a wide range of courses and sessions directed at exactly this fundamental question.
How to let go of all those acquired self-limiting beliefs?
So we can then simply relax and discover our true meditative potential.
Both online and offline.

#### To explore living & dying through meditation

[Meditation as a Window into Dying][95] – Foundational to OSHO Sammasati’s approach is meditation as
a way to be more conscious in our dying as well as in our living. In this article we explore some of
the ways in which meditation and dying are similar.

[How to Die Consciously][96] – Forming the most significant and unique feature of our site, these
articles explain why we advocate dying consciously, how to prepare for it, being with fear, and
knowing ourselves as other than the body-mind: as the inner observer.

See more from the [Meditation & Dying Consciously][97] section of our [Death & Dying Toolkit][98].

Our [Index of Meditations][99] includes the section [Meditations in Dying][100] giving methods for
those who are dying or who wish to use meditation to explore death whilst healthy.

Our [Meditation Toolkit][101] provides a wealth of meditation methods and meditation resources
including guidance (some from [Osho][102]) about meditating during different phases of life – in
health & ageing, in illness & pain, in dying or bereavement and in caring for someone who is
seriously ill or dying.

Suggestions of how to guide someone else in meditation, audio products, details of meditation
workshops and articles on meditation can also be found in the Meditation Toolkit.

[Illness and pain - Leaf green shadow][Illness and pain - Leaf green shadow]Our [Illness &
Pain][103] section looks at meeting challenges and change. It includes Meditations, articles and
resources to support you when you or those you are caring for are ill, in pain, unconscious or
facing other health challenges or disabilities.

[Find meditations][104] to help you or your friend deal with [Pain][105] and [Illness][106].

If you are a carer, visit the [Supporting the Ill & Dying][107] section and our [Carer
Toolkit][108].

Links not working or any other issues? Please see the FAQ.

#### You are dying

[Facing one's own imminent death][Facing one's own imminent death]See [Facing one’s own imminent
death][109] – perhaps after receiving a [terminal diagnosis][110]. This links to resources at this
important phase of your life, including how to respond to the [issues][111] that you might be
facing, deal with [emotional changes][112] and [die consciously][113].

Our [Index of Meditations][114] includes [Meditations in Dying][115] giving methods for those who
are dying – to be practised personally or to be guided in meditation.

Part of the emphasis of this website is the emphasis that we are all dying – that life and death is
a continuum. However, when we realise that death is close, we can prepare ourselves and our loved
ones mentally, emotionally and spiritually as well as planning the [practicalities][116]. See the
many resources in our [Death & Dying Toolkit][117].

#### To explore living & dying through meditation

[Meditation as a Window into Dying][95] – Foundational to OSHO Sammasati’s approach is meditation as
a way to be more conscious in our dying as well as in our living. In this article we explore some of
the ways in which meditation and dying are similar.

[How to Die Consciously][96] – Forming the most significant and unique feature of our site, these
articles explain why we advocate dying consciously, how to prepare for it, being with fear, and
knowing ourselves as other than the body-mind: as the inner observer.

See more from the [Meditation & Dying Consciously][97] section of our [Death & Dying Toolkit][98].

Our [Index of Meditations][99] includes the section [Meditations in Dying][100] giving methods for
those who are dying or who wish to use meditation to explore death whilst healthy.

Our [Meditation Toolkit][101] provides a wealth of meditation methods and meditation resources
including guidance (some from [Osho][102]) about meditating during different phases of life – in
health & ageing, in illness & pain, in dying or bereavement and in caring for someone who is
seriously ill or dying.

Suggestions of how to guide someone else in meditation, audio products, details of meditation
workshops and articles on meditation can also be found in the Meditation Toolkit.

Links not working or any other issues? Please see the FAQ.

#### You or a friend are ill or in pain

[Illness and pain - Leaf green shadow][Illness and pain - Leaf green shadow]Our [Illness &
Pain][103] section looks at meeting challenges and change. It includes Meditations, articles and
resources to support you when you or those you are caring for are ill, in pain, unconscious or
facing other health challenges or disabilities.

[Find meditations][104] to help you or your friend deal with [Pain][105] and [Illness][106].

If you are a carer, visit the [Supporting the Ill & Dying][107] section and our [Carer
Toolkit][108].

Links not working or any other issues? Please see the FAQ.

×

#### You are dying

[Facing one's own imminent death][Facing one's own imminent death]See [Facing one’s own imminent
death][109] – perhaps after receiving a [terminal diagnosis][110]. This links to resources at this
important phase of your life, including how to respond to the [issues][111] that you might be
facing, deal with [emotional changes][112] and [die consciously][113].

Our [Index of Meditations][114] includes [Meditations in Dying][115] giving methods for those who
are dying – to be practised personally or to be guided in meditation.

Part of the emphasis of this website is the emphasis that we are all dying – that life and death is
a continuum. However, when we realise that death is close, we can prepare ourselves and our loved
ones mentally, emotionally and spiritually as well as planning the [practicalities][116]. See the
many resources in our [Death & Dying Toolkit][117].

Links not working or any other issues? Please see the FAQ.

×

#### Someone you know is dying

[A Guide to Visiting the Dying][A Guide to Visiting the Dying]Download our *[Guide to Visiting the
Dying][118]*

See our [Death & Dying Toolkit][119]. This toolkit is primarily for a person who is dying. It has
many resources that will also be of help to those caring for someone who is dying. Carers, see our
[Toolkit for Carers][120].

Links not working or any other issues? Please see the FAQ.

×

#### You want to be able to support those who are sick or dying

[Supporting the ill & dying][Supporting the ill & dying]See [Supporting the Ill & Dying][121].
Familiarise yourself with the many resources available, from suggestions when visiting the dying,
[communication tips][122], to how to [guide someone in meditation][123], and how to care for
yourself as a carer.

This section offers support for
• Carers of the seriously ill or dying
• Family and friends visiting a dying person
• Hospice Volunteers
• Medical & Other Professionals serving the Dying

Download our *[Guide to Visiting the Dying][124]*

See our [Carer Toolkit][125]

Links not working or any other issues? Please see the FAQ.

×

#### You are a professional working with the sick and dying

For hospice volunteers and medical and other professionals serving the dying – our website
emphasizes the benefits of supporting people through meditation and sensitive relating, supporting
those in the dying process to die peacefully and consciously.

[Supporting the ill & dying][Supporting the ill & dying]See [Supporting the Ill & Dying][126].
Familiarise yourself with the many resources available, from suggestions when visiting the dying,
[communication tips][127], to how to [guide someone in meditation][128], and how to care for
yourself as a carer.

Download our *[Guide to Visiting the Dying][129]*

See our [Carer Toolkit][130]

Links not working or any other issues? Please see the FAQ.

×

#### You have been bereaved

[After Death][After Death]See [After Death][131]. In this section we look at what happens after a
death, both immediately and in the following days, weeks and months. We cover the practical aspects
and also give some suggestions about dealing with [bereavement and grief][132].

Links not working or any other issues? Please see the FAQ.

×

#### You are interested in our workshops

[Workshops & Events at OSHO Sammasati][Workshops & Events at OSHO Sammasati]See [Workshops & Events
on Living-dying][133] – a summary of OSHO Sammasati workshops offered internationally. See our
[Calendar][134] for details and also check out the [Testimonials][135] and [Photo Gallery][136].

Workshops are generally facilitated by [Maneesha James][137] and [Sudheer P. Niet][138].

Maneesha and Sudheer also offer [individual sessions][139].

If you are interested in organising a workshop with us, please [contact Maneesha][140].

Body Positive

Alcohol free

For all

## Class Types

### better—together.

1:1 Guidance

### free flow

be yourself with others.During Free Flows you have the freedom to chart your own course through the
elements, while our experienced Guides are available for those seeking one-on-one support.

75 mins
Unguided

playlist will keep you chilled out in more ways than one.

75 mins
Guided

Consider this our icy-fresh take on an evening out with friends. A 2-hour sober-curious gathering to
connect with others over a shared sense of play and aliveness.Together, we unite to shift our state
and build belonging from a place of open receptivity.

120 mins
Unguided
[Book evening social][45]

energize + uplift

Embark on an immersive journey through the sauna and ice bath to stoke your inner fire and create a
vibrant sense of aliveness.Led by an experienced guide, we unite to awaken the body + mind and
emerge with a new sense of vitality.

75 mins
Guided
[Book UP CLASS][46]
[People in swimsuits stretching in a sauna class]
UNTANGLE + restore

Embark on an immersive journey through the sauna and ice bath to untangle tension and release modern
stress from the body + mind.
Led by an experienced guide, we come together for a soothing journey of self-care to recalibrate the
body + mind.

75 mins
Guided
[Book down class][47]
[A couple hugging each other while sticking out their tongues under a shower stream]
Release + REGULATE

Embark on an immersive journey through the sauna and ice bath to navigate + regulate your emotions,
in a world that can’t be regulated.Led by an experienced guide, we explore the most profound of
human emotions, creating a supportive space for self-discovery and transformation.

75 mins
Guided
[Book ALL AROUND][48]

sauna

50-100 person sauna made from Western Red Cedar. Temperates range from 60°C to 100°C.

ice bath

Two-person cold plunge tubs that range from 0°C to 4°C.

tea lounge

Sit around an indoor fireplace in our tea lounge and drink complimentary herbal tea.

lockers

Free lockers available to store your belongings while you sweat.

towels

Two towels included at every session. Use one to sit on in the sauna, and the other to dry off with
after your session.

guide

Guides trained in the art and science of sauna therapy, ice baths, and breathwork to support you on
your journey.

## What Is Positivity?

**Positivity** is the quality and practice of being positive — a science-backed orientation toward
what is good, constructive, and hopeful in life. It encompasses optimistic thinking, grateful
awareness, and the intentional cultivation of uplifting emotions like joy, love, gratitude, and
serenity.

Rooted in [positive psychology][73] research by Dr. Martin Seligman and Dr. Barbara Fredrickson,
positivity is not about ignoring problems — it is about building the mental and emotional resources
to face them with resilience. Studies show that people who practice positivity experience **35%
lower heart disease risk**, **stronger immune function**, and **greater life satisfaction**.

At **Positivity.org**, we provide free, evidence-based tools to help you practice positivity daily:
[750+ affirmations][74], [20+ guided meditation scripts][75], [inspirational quotes][76],
interactive [wellness tools][77], and in-depth articles on mindfulness, habits, and emotional
growth.

Whether you are starting your day with a [daily affirmation][78], exploring the [growth
mindset][79], or finding calm through [guided meditation][80] — every small step toward positivity
creates lasting change in your brain, body, and relationships.

## What Is Positivity?

**Positivity** is the quality and practice of being positive — a science-backed orientation toward
what is good, constructive, and hopeful in life. It encompasses optimistic thinking, grateful
awareness, and the intentional cultivation of uplifting emotions like joy, love, gratitude, and
serenity.

Rooted in [positive psychology][73] research by Dr. Martin Seligman and Dr. Barbara Fredrickson,
positivity is not about ignoring problems — it is about building the mental and emotional resources
to face them with resilience. Studies show that people who practice positivity experience **35%
lower heart disease risk**, **stronger immune function**, and **greater life satisfaction**.

At **Positivity.org**, we provide free, evidence-based tools to help you practice positivity daily:
[750+ affirmations][74], [20+ guided meditation scripts][75], [inspirational quotes][76],
interactive [wellness tools][77], and in-depth articles on mindfulness, habits, and emotional
growth.

Whether you are starting your day with a [daily affirmation][78], exploring the [growth
mindset][79], or finding calm through [guided meditation][80] — every small step toward positivity
creates lasting change in your brain, body, and relationships.

[Read our complete guide to positivity →][81]

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ What do I need to get started? How Can I Accessorize for Meditation?
][109]

To start practicing Preksha meditation, you need to find a quiet place where you can meditate. If
you choose to sit or lie down, you will need a mat. You can wear whatever you are wearing if you
feel comfortable with it. No other accessories are required for Preksha meditation.

[ Where should I meditate?
][110]

There is no strict rule about where to meditate; you can meditate wherever you are. It is good to
have a regular place for daily meditation which will build conducive atmosphere. If you find it hard
to fix a place, you can practice at desk or even while you travel. You can meditate in religious and
community places or at Preksha Meditation centers. Meditate wherever you feel comfortable. As you
grow in meditation, you will be able to practice no matter where you are.

[ Whom should I contact to learn Preksha Meditation?
][111]

Please refer our website [www.preksha.com][112] for contact details. You can also e-mail directly to
[[email protected]][113] mentioning your name & contact details.

[ What are the abc's of meditation?
][114]

There are a few recommended guidelines for meditation:
* It should be done every day, preferably at the same time
* It should preferably be done before a meal rather than after a meal
* A spot should be set aside for meditation, which should be a quiet place and used for nothing but
  meditation
* One should sit with the spine straight and vertical(a chair may be used if needed)

[ How do I learn to meditate?
][115]

The best way to learn to meditate is by practicing it. To learn the basics of Preksha Meditation,
you may attend a camp, use guided meditation or even learn it by reading. But the key lies in
practicing what you have learnt. It is like learning to swim. Unless you do it, you really do little
to reach your goal. You don’t know what lies in the ocean unless you dive in. The desire and
willingness is the measure which can take you far in the journey of learning meditation, learning
about your inner self.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ View All Faqs ][108]
[ What do I need to get started? How Can I Accessorize for Meditation?
][109]

To start practicing Preksha meditation, you need to find a quiet place where you can meditate. If
you choose to sit or lie down, you will need a mat. You can wear whatever you are wearing if you
feel comfortable with it. No other accessories are required for Preksha meditation.

[ Where should I meditate?
][110]

There is no strict rule about where to meditate; you can meditate wherever you are. It is good to
have a regular place for daily meditation which will build conducive atmosphere. If you find it hard
to fix a place, you can practice at desk or even while you travel. You can meditate in religious and
community places or at Preksha Meditation centers. Meditate wherever you feel comfortable. As you
grow in meditation, you will be able to practice no matter where you are.

[ Whom should I contact to learn Preksha Meditation?
][111]

Please refer our website [www.preksha.com][112] for contact details. You can also e-mail directly to
[[email protected]][113] mentioning your name & contact details.

[ What are the abc's of meditation?
][114]

There are a few recommended guidelines for meditation:
* It should be done every day, preferably at the same time
* It should preferably be done before a meal rather than after a meal
* A spot should be set aside for meditation, which should be a quiet place and used for nothing but
  meditation
* One should sit with the spine straight and vertical(a chair may be used if needed)

[ How do I learn to meditate?
][115]

The best way to learn to meditate is by practicing it. To learn the basics of Preksha Meditation,
you may attend a camp, use guided meditation or even learn it by reading. But the key lies in
practicing what you have learnt. It is like learning to swim. Unless you do it, you really do little
to reach your goal. You don’t know what lies in the ocean unless you dive in. The desire and
willingness is the measure which can take you far in the journey of learning meditation, learning
about your inner self.

# Rigpa: Bring the Mind Home

## Rigpa is a community dedicated to awakening the vast potential of wisdom and compassion we all
## have, which is so often hidden by the distractions of everyday life.

[ Learn to meditate ][114]
* [ Upcoming Events ][115]
[ Join next event ][116]

Drawing its name from the Tibetan word ‘rigpa’—the ever-present, pristine awareness of the nature of
mind—Rigpa offers a complete, authentic path of study and meditation leading to enlightenment,
following the tradition of Tibetan Buddhism.

Rigpa is open to anyone looking for more community, inspiration and inner strength in this uncertain
and chaotic world.

[ Learn More ][117]
[Sogyal Script][Sogyal Script] OM MANI PADME HUNG HRIH

## What we offer

### Meditate

Meditation is discovering a way of ‘being’ rather than ‘doing’. Come to know your mind and its
habits, and to work skilfully and kindly with emotions and more.

[ Find out more about meditation ][118]

### Find a group

Rigpa is open to anyone looking for more community, inspiration and inner strength and the tools to
alleviate suffering in this uncertain and chaotic world.

[ Find a group near you ][119]

### Explore Programmes

Online and in-person, Rigpa’s courses and retreats in groups and centres worldwide offer many ways
to explore and practise what Buddha taught.

[ Find a programme that suits you ][120]

# Rigpa: Bring the Mind Home

## Rigpa is a community dedicated to awakening the vast potential of wisdom and compassion we all
## have, which is so often hidden by the distractions of everyday life.

[ Learn to meditate ][114]
* [ Upcoming Events ][115]
[ Join next event ][116]

Drawing its name from the Tibetan word ‘rigpa’—the ever-present, pristine awareness of the nature of
mind—Rigpa offers a complete, authentic path of study and meditation leading to enlightenment,
following the tradition of Tibetan Buddhism.

Rigpa is open to anyone looking for more community, inspiration and inner strength in this uncertain
and chaotic world.

[ Learn More ][117]
[Sogyal Script][Sogyal Script] OM MANI PADME HUNG HRIH

## What we offer

### Meditate

Meditation is discovering a way of ‘being’ rather than ‘doing’. Come to know your mind and its
habits, and to work skilfully and kindly with emotions and more.

[ Find out more about meditation ][118]

### Find a group

Rigpa is open to anyone looking for more community, inspiration and inner strength and the tools to
alleviate suffering in this uncertain and chaotic world.

[ Find a group near you ][119]

### Explore Programmes

Online and in-person, Rigpa’s courses and retreats in groups and centres worldwide offer many ways
to explore and practise what Buddha taught.

[ Find a programme that suits you ][120]
SimAustralia
I’ve never experienced a community quite like Rigpa. The depth of care, commitment to seeing things
through and clear communication amongst its members constantly astounds and inspires me. It’s as
though pure sunshine illuminates every corner of Rigpa’s operations, making the experience of being
part of this community one of great ease, connectedness and true belonging.
VanessaFrance
I want to express my deep gratitude to the course leaders for the quality of your teachings,
interest, patience and open mindedness and for always clarifying our existential questions. I also
benefited greatly from the sincerity between students during the discussion groups.
RickUSA

I want to express my deep gratitude to the course leaders for the quality of your teachings,

RickUSA
At 72, I was looking for a framework to understand loss and death when I discovered Rigpa's course
on dying — my first introduction to Buddhism. Everyone was welcoming and helpful. Since then, I've
been meditating daily and am already noticing real changes: I feel more open, compassionate and
level-headed when facing life's difficulties. I'm grateful for that wonderful beginning.
AndyAustralia
I found the Rigpa retreat and the instructors excellent. I really appreciated their joyfulness,
clarity, warmth and generosity. It has had a big impact on me and had a terrific impact on my daily
meditation practice.
VeroniqueFrance
What I apppreciated most in this [beginners] course was the clarity of the teachers’ explanations,
the absence of judgements and pressure, I feel good after listening to these teachings. Now I
understand the meaning and the kindness from the Sangha.
IanAustralia
Through a friend I connected with Rigpa and found a wonderful community which quickly felt like “my
people”. I really appreciate the incredibly well structured courses, particularly the Home Retreat,
which gives me the confidence that I’m following a complete spiritual path, with the support of my
teachers and friends. I feel so lucky to have found this community.

those using other methods. Whether insomnia or sleep deprivation are the result of life’s daily

condition, iRest can help.

[More about iRest][88]

**Try a Quick iRest**

iRest is typically taught as a guided meditation. Below you will find samples of iRest meditations
you can listen to guided by Richard Miller, PhD, creator of iRest. These recordings are designed for
everyone; both experienced iRest practitioners and newcomers alike.

**8 minute iRest practice for a restful nap** [ Download audio ][89] **20 minute iRest practice for
deep and restful sleep** [ Download audio ][90]

** Ready to dive deeper?**

Checkout "[Reclaiming Restful Sleep][91]." Sleep is essential to our overall health. It’s as vital
as food, water, and air. Sometimes a restorative night’s sleep eludes us, especially during times of
stress and worry. Engaging in daytime and nighttime practices can help ease your body and mind so
that you’re able to fall asleep, stay asleep, and take short rests during the day.

### Resolve Trauma

# Restore Peace with iRest

With iRest, you will discover that you have an indestructible inner resource of strength, calm and
ease, no matter what you have experienced in the past or what challenges you face now.

[Try iRest Now][92]

 

**How does iRest resolve trauma?**

iRest is an evidence-based form of guided meditation that has been shown to resolve symptoms
associated with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). The simple steps of iRest (which have been
tested in clinical trials) calm the nervous system, release stress, increase resiliency and restore
a sense of balance and control.

iRest is easy to learn and can be practiced by anyone. Even short practices of 10 or 20 minutes can
bring about a sense of calm and ease and the ability to face difficult or stressful situations.

There are currently iRest programs in active duty military and Veteran’s Health Administration
medical facilities across the United States, as well as in correctional facilities, hospices,
homeless shelters, clinics and schools around the globe. Based on current studies with iRest in the
military and veteran community, the Defense Centers of Excellence for Psychological Health and
Traumatic Brain Injury recognizes iRest as a Complementary and Alternative Medicine warranting
continuing research for its use in the treatment of post-traumatic stress.

everyone; both experienced iRest practitioners and newcomers alike.

** Ready to dive deeper?**

Checkout "[42 iRest Yoga Nidra Meditations with Richard Miller][96]." This collection of iRest Yoga
Nidra meditations is comprised of practices for health, healing, resiliency and well-being that
support well-being across all dimensions of your life. These 42 recorded meditations are based on
the scripts that can be found within the chapters of Richard Miller's book, The iRest Program for
Healing PTSD. Each recording is designed to help you learn the iRest Program, step-by-step, as well
as help you weave iRest into the fabric of your daily life. You have in your hands a powerful and
essential tool for healing, and achieving well-being and true peace of mind, wherever you are,
whomever you’re with, whatever you’re doing.

### Relieve Chronic Pain

# Alleviate Chronic Pain with iRest

With iRest meditation, people have found relief from chronic pain that medication and other
pain-management programs are unable to resolve.

[Try iRest Now][97]

**How does iRest alleviate Chronic Pain? **

With iRest meditation, people have found relief from chronic pain that medication and other
pain-management programs have been unable to resolve. A scientific study has shown that iRest
reduces the intensity of pain and the extent to which pain interferes with daily life.

iRest is easy to learn yet powerful - It works by enabling you to deeply relax, focus attention,
experience the underlying calm and wellbeing that is already present in your body and mind, and
begin to understand pain rather than just resist it. iRest has historically been endorsed by the
U.S. Army Surgeon General as a form of complementary and alternative medicine for addressing pain
management.

Anyone can learn iRest, and you can practice it wherever and whenever you need relief.

*"I suffer from chronic pain as a result of nerve damage from brain surgery. … Since beginning my
practice of iRest, I have been almost pain free, and when I have needed medication, it has been much
less than before. … I feel as if I have my life back…”*

**- Marci Alegant, participant at an iRest Retreat**

that either ameliorate the pain or help them step out of it completely. We’ve seen miracles where
the pain ends completely, and others learn tools to manage their pain and not be overcome by it.
This informative two-part webinar explains: How iRest Yoga Nidra incorporates and addresses the
fundamental principles of pain science Why the iRest Protocol is so effective for meeting and
managing pain How to adapt the protocol for your personal practice, or when facilitating groups and
individuals experiencing pain.

Everyone needs a way to feel at ease when life gets tough. iRest helps you discover a place inside
yourself that is calm - even when life is not.

[Try iRest Now][102]

If you're looking for a way to feel at ease when life gets challenging or overwhelming, iRest can

[Meditate 7 days a week]
 

Space2Meditate offers the opportunity to sit on-line with the support of community [**7 days a
week**][54]. Wild, right? We can do this thanks to a wonderful [team][55] of teachers and
volunteers, and the incredible support of our community. We also host residential retreats and a
range of other events and gatherings.

**We invite you to join us and to get to know us. **You will discover that we like poetry (a lot),
coffee (also a lot), keeping it real and a good laugh now and again. Cause it’s rough out there.

**Our practice style?** We don’t avoid the headlines. Instead, we work with what is happening in the
world right here, in the crucible of meditation and community. Together, we try to metabolize what
the heck is going on, the macro, the micro, and everything in between.

**Give yourself Space2Meditate.**

[ Join Us ][56]
 
[
][57]

Practice contemplative living from home — with guided meditations, Dharma teachings, and community
support.
Flexible to fit your real life.
Join live or follow along with daily recordings.
Open to all levels.
Offered on the basis of generosity.

[ Find Out More! ][58]
 

## [Join us][59].

### **Stop, Drop, Sit and *Connect***

Silent meditation 7am EST 7days/week
Guided meditation 8am EST 7days/week
BIPOC Community Sit 2X month on Sat 8:45am
Monthly Dharma Nights - 2nd Sundays 7pm EST
Monthly Sangha Nights - 4th Sundays 7pm EST
And a bunch of other cool resources and wonderful humans

[ See the full schedule ][60]
 

We’re chill. We don’t take attendance! Some folks come every day, others drop in from time to time,
and everything in between. It’s all good.

There is a core group that is quite steady and will always delight in seeing new and returning
faces.

Some folks just want to meditate. Others like to also connect with one another. No pressure either
way. Engage in a way that works for you.

[ FIND OUT MORE ][61]
 
[s2m homepage .gif]

**How does it all work? We operate on the basis of gift economics. **

Everything we do is fueled by the generosity of community.

No one is turned away for lack of funds.

[ Join us! ][62]
[ Our Vision for Sustainability ][63]

* #### About Upayadhi
  
  My journey in the Dharma began in 2004 at the London Buddhist Centre in Bethnal Green. Since
  stumbling onto my first meditation cushion, I've trained across a range of Buddhist traditions,
  but I remain rooted in the Triratna Buddhist Order, to which I was ordained in 2018.
  
  My professional background is in leadership development, executive education, and coaching. The
  2016 elections were a turning point — I entered Union Theological Seminary in New York, where I
  studied Buddhism and Inter-religious Engagement. I'm currently pursuing doctoral work in Religious
  Studies at the University of Chicago Divinity School.
  
  I co-founded Awareness is Revolutionary, a collective cultivating Beloved Community and racial
  literacy within a Dharmic framework. I'm also a certified MBSR teacher and have practiced as an
  interfaith chaplain in hospice and hospital settings. When the pandemic hit, Jon Aaron and I
  co-founded Space2Meditate.
  
  I was born and raised in France, and am of Italian heritage. My name is a reference to the
  qualities of wisdom (dhi) and compassion in action (upaya) in the Buddhist tradition.
  
  You can find out more about me and my training pathway on my personal website.
* #### Stuff we might talk about…
  
  My zig-zag of a life has taken quite a few 180-degree turns — which makes me a good conversation
  partner for anyone living with paradox or standing at some kind of crossroads. I'm a Third Culture
  Kid, a Buddhist chaplain, a mindfulness-based coach, a recovering corporate executive, and a queer
  white woman doing anti-racism work in Buddhist spaces. Also: a card-carrying nerd addicted to
  learning (currently in grad school for the third time), and a deep introvert who genuinely wants
  to connect but needs a little coaxing out from under her rock. (That's your cue — book a chat.)
  
  Here's the kind of territory I love exploring with people: meditation and Dharma practice;
  belonging and identity; big scary life transitions; messy race, sexuality, and gender stuff; and
  the group dynamics and intercultural misreads that drive us nuts. We might go deep on what
  collective liberation actually feels/looks like; what healing really takes; how to survive
  late-stage capitalism with your heart somewhat intact; or why pleasure is crucial for resistance.
  Theological rabbit holes? Career and what-do-I-do-with-my-life conundrums? Difficult communication
  with loved ones, and lesser loved ones? Existential dread at 2am? All welcome. I'm here for it.
  Let's talk.
[ Book a chat with Upayadhi ][66]
 
[
][67]
* #### About Jon Aaron
  
  I first encountered meditation in the 1970s, and by the late 1990s I had found my way into the
  Insight Meditation community, where mindfulness and Buddhism became central to my life. What began
  as personal practice gradually evolved into teaching. That has included bridging into more secular
  forms of mindfulness meditation.
  
  I've now taught over 130 cycles of the Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction (MBSR) curriculum and
  train MBSR teachers across the US, Hungary, and Japan. To deepen my understanding of trauma, I've
  also trained as a Somatic Experiencing Practitioner.
  
  I teach regularly at the New York Insight Meditation Center, lead a weekly Insight Sangha in
  Chicago, and co-founded the Space2Meditate community in 2020. I'm also a co-founder of the
  Mindfulness Teacher Training Alliance and a founding member of the Global Mindfulness
  Collaborative.
  
  Before turning to teaching full-time, I spent over 30 years as an agent and producer in the
  performing arts. That chapter shaped me — and this one continues to.
  
  You can find out more about me, my path of training and my teachers on my [personal website][68],
  as well as through my podcast, [Diggin’ the Dharma.][69]
* #### Stuff we might talk about...
  
  I spent over 30 years as an agent and producer in the performing arts — then somehow ended up as a
  meditation teacher. No master plan, just a slow drift toward what felt most alive.
  
  Here's what I am now: a lifelong student of Buddhism and meditation who keeps finding there's more
  to learn, a trauma-informed practitioner, and someone who believes paying attention might be the
  most radical thing any of us can do.
  
  Here's the kind of territory I love exploring with people: uncertainty, stress, burnout, loss, and
  the overwhelm of modern life; sitting with pain — physical, emotional, existential; what it
  actually means to show up for your own experience; and the slow, unglamorous, deeply worthwhile
  work of waking up.
  
  New to meditation? Seasoned practitioner hitting a wall? Teacher looking for support? Curious
  about MBSR? Humanoid just trying to get through the day? All welcome.
  
  Basically: if you're interested in living with a little more awareness and a little less suffering
  — let's talk!

[Meditate 7 days a week]
 

Space2Meditate offers the opportunity to sit on-line with the support of community [**7 days a
week**][54]. Wild, right? We can do this thanks to a wonderful [team][55] of teachers and
volunteers, and the incredible support of our community. We also host residential retreats and a
range of other events and gatherings.

**We invite you to join us and to get to know us. **You will discover that we like poetry (a lot),
coffee (also a lot), keeping it real and a good laugh now and again. Cause it’s rough out there.

**Our practice style?** We don’t avoid the headlines. Instead, we work with what is happening in the
world right here, in the crucible of meditation and community. Together, we try to metabolize what
the heck is going on, the macro, the micro, and everything in between.

**Give yourself Space2Meditate.**

[ Join Us ][56]
 
[
][57]

Practice contemplative living from home — with guided meditations, Dharma teachings, and community
support.
Flexible to fit your real life.
Join live or follow along with daily recordings.
Open to all levels.
Offered on the basis of generosity.

[ Find Out More! ][58]
 

## [Join us][59].

### **Stop, Drop, Sit and *Connect***

Silent meditation 7am EST 7days/week
Guided meditation 8am EST 7days/week
BIPOC Community Sit 2X month on Sat 8:45am
Monthly Dharma Nights - 2nd Sundays 7pm EST
Monthly Sangha Nights - 4th Sundays 7pm EST
And a bunch of other cool resources and wonderful humans

[ See the full schedule ][60]
 

We’re chill. We don’t take attendance! Some folks come every day, others drop in from time to time,
and everything in between. It’s all good.

There is a core group that is quite steady and will always delight in seeing new and returning
faces.

Some folks just want to meditate. Others like to also connect with one another. No pressure either
way. Engage in a way that works for you.

[ FIND OUT MORE ][61]
 
[s2m homepage .gif]

**How does it all work? We operate on the basis of gift economics. **

Everything we do is fueled by the generosity of community.

No one is turned away for lack of funds.

[ Join us! ][62]
[ Our Vision for Sustainability ][63]

us. We meet with individuals on the basis of mutual generosity, on a sliding scale. At the links

[ Learn more ][64]
[
][65]
* #### About Upayadhi
  
  My journey in the Dharma began in 2004 at the London Buddhist Centre in Bethnal Green. Since
  stumbling onto my first meditation cushion, I've trained across a range of Buddhist traditions,
  but I remain rooted in the Triratna Buddhist Order, to which I was ordained in 2018.
  
  My professional background is in leadership development, executive education, and coaching. The
  2016 elections were a turning point — I entered Union Theological Seminary in New York, where I
  studied Buddhism and Inter-religious Engagement. I'm currently pursuing doctoral work in Religious
  Studies at the University of Chicago Divinity School.
  
  I co-founded Awareness is Revolutionary, a collective cultivating Beloved Community and racial
  literacy within a Dharmic framework. I'm also a certified MBSR teacher and have practiced as an
  interfaith chaplain in hospice and hospital settings. When the pandemic hit, Jon Aaron and I
  co-founded Space2Meditate.
  
  I was born and raised in France, and am of Italian heritage. My name is a reference to the
  qualities of wisdom (dhi) and compassion in action (upaya) in the Buddhist tradition.
  
  You can find out more about me and my training pathway on my personal website.
* #### Stuff we might talk about…
  
  My zig-zag of a life has taken quite a few 180-degree turns — which makes me a good conversation
  partner for anyone living with paradox or standing at some kind of crossroads. I'm a Third Culture
  Kid, a Buddhist chaplain, a mindfulness-based coach, a recovering corporate executive, and a queer
  white woman doing anti-racism work in Buddhist spaces. Also: a card-carrying nerd addicted to
  learning (currently in grad school for the third time), and a deep introvert who genuinely wants
  to connect but needs a little coaxing out from under her rock. (That's your cue — book a chat.)
  
  Here's the kind of territory I love exploring with people: meditation and Dharma practice;
  belonging and identity; big scary life transitions; messy race, sexuality, and gender stuff; and
  the group dynamics and intercultural misreads that drive us nuts. We might go deep on what
  collective liberation actually feels/looks like; what healing really takes; how to survive
  late-stage capitalism with your heart somewhat intact; or why pleasure is crucial for resistance.
  Theological rabbit holes? Career and what-do-I-do-with-my-life conundrums? Difficult communication
  with loved ones, and lesser loved ones? Existential dread at 2am? All welcome. I'm here for it.
  Let's talk.
[ Book a chat with Upayadhi ][66]
 
[
][67]
* #### About Jon Aaron
  
  I first encountered meditation in the 1970s, and by the late 1990s I had found my way into the
  Insight Meditation community, where mindfulness and Buddhism became central to my life. What began
  as personal practice gradually evolved into teaching. That has included bridging into more secular
  forms of mindfulness meditation.
  
  I've now taught over 130 cycles of the Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction (MBSR) curriculum and
  train MBSR teachers across the US, Hungary, and Japan. To deepen my understanding of trauma, I've
  also trained as a Somatic Experiencing Practitioner.
  
  I teach regularly at the New York Insight Meditation Center, lead a weekly Insight Sangha in
  Chicago, and co-founded the Space2Meditate community in 2020. I'm also a co-founder of the
  Mindfulness Teacher Training Alliance and a founding member of the Global Mindfulness
  Collaborative.
  
  Before turning to teaching full-time, I spent over 30 years as an agent and producer in the
  performing arts. That chapter shaped me — and this one continues to.
  
  You can find out more about me, my path of training and my teachers on my [personal website][68],
  as well as through my podcast, [Diggin’ the Dharma.][69]
* #### Stuff we might talk about...
  
  I spent over 30 years as an agent and producer in the performing arts — then somehow ended up as a
  meditation teacher. No master plan, just a slow drift toward what felt most alive.
  
  Here's what I am now: a lifelong student of Buddhism and meditation who keeps finding there's more
  to learn, a trauma-informed practitioner, and someone who believes paying attention might be the
  most radical thing any of us can do.
  
  Here's the kind of territory I love exploring with people: uncertainty, stress, burnout, loss, and
  the overwhelm of modern life; sitting with pain — physical, emotional, existential; what it
  actually means to show up for your own experience; and the slow, unglamorous, deeply worthwhile
  work of waking up.
  
  New to meditation? Seasoned practitioner hitting a wall? Teacher looking for support? Curious
  about MBSR? Humanoid just trying to get through the day? All welcome.
  
  Basically: if you're interested in living with a little more awareness and a little less suffering
  — let's talk!
[ Book a chat with Jon ][70]

The Santa Cruz Meditation Group of Self-Realization Fellowship was formed in 1977 with the purpose
of bringing spiritual seekers together to promote their spiritual growth through group meditation
and spiritual fellowship. We welcome all to a sanctuary of peace with which to help balance
meditation and activity in our daily lives and to share and practice the teachings of Paramahansa
Yogananda. 

## [SELF-REALIZATION FELLOWSHIP][19]

Through its world wide service and teachings, SRF seeks to awaken greater understanding of the
harmony underlying all religions, and fuller expression of the love that unites all people when they
realize their oneness in God.

 

 

## [MEDITATION][20]


*"To commune daily with God in deep meditation and to carry His love and guidance with you into all
your dutiful activities, is the way that leads to permanent peace and happiness." *
*--* Paramahansa Yogananda

 

 

[Contact the Santa Cruz Meditation Group][21]

## [SERVICES][22]


*“Group meditation is a castle that protects the new spiritual aspirants as well as the veteran
meditators. Meditating together increases the degree of self-realization of each member of the group
by the law of invisible vibratory exchange of group magnetism.” 
  *– Paramahansa Yogananda

The Santa Cruz Meditation Group of Self-Realization Fellowship was formed in 1977 with the purpose
of bringing spiritual seekers together to promote their spiritual growth through group meditation
and spiritual fellowship. We welcome all to a sanctuary of peace with which to help balance
meditation and activity in our daily lives and to share and practice the teachings of Paramahansa
Yogananda. 

## [SELF-REALIZATION FELLOWSHIP][19]

Through its world wide service and teachings, SRF seeks to awaken greater understanding of the
harmony underlying all religions, and fuller expression of the love that unites all people when they
realize their oneness in God.

 

 

## [MEDITATION][20]


*"To commune daily with God in deep meditation and to carry His love and guidance with you into all
your dutiful activities, is the way that leads to permanent peace and happiness." *
*--* Paramahansa Yogananda

 

 

[Contact the Santa Cruz Meditation Group][21]

## [SERVICES][22]


*“Group meditation is a castle that protects the new spiritual aspirants as well as the veteran
meditators. Meditating together increases the degree of self-realization of each member of the group
by the law of invisible vibratory exchange of group magnetism.” 
  *– Paramahansa Yogananda

#### Our mission is to transform hearts and minds by making the ancient wisdom of meditation
#### accessible to the modern world.

#### [Learn More About Us][130]

## Mingyur Rinpoche

Yongey  Mingyur Rinpoche is a teacher, best-selling author, and the guiding teacher of the worldwide
Tergar Meditation Community. He possesses a rare ability to present the ancient wisdom of Tibet in a
fresh, engaging manner. His profound yet accessible teachings and playful sense of humor have
endeared him to students around the world. Most uniquely, Rinpoche’s teachings weave together his
own personal experiences with modern scientific research, relating both to the practice of
meditation.

[ Read full biography ][131]

## Find Your Tergar Community

**We grow together by practicing awareness, compassion, and wisdom in Tergar groups and communities
around the globe. We believe that the power of this practice has a ripple effect on the whole
world.**

# 30

#### Countries

# 108

# 20

#### languages

[ Join Now ][132]

### Upcoming Offerings

#### The Primordial Secret: Dzogchen Teachings on Resting in the Natural State

***August 15–17, 2026***

In this opening retreat of Tergar’s new year-long Dzogchen transmission, Mingyur Rinpoche will
transmit the crucial first sections of the *Heart Essence of the Primordial Secret* instruction
manual.

[ Learn More & Register → ][133]

#### New Course: Voices of Dzogchen

***August 1–26, 2026***

Voices of Dzogchen offers live webinars with prominent Buddhist teachers who embody the Dzogchen
tradition: Mingyur Rinpoche, Erik Pema Kunsang, Richard Barron (Lama Chökyi Nyima), and Sangye
Khandro.

[ Learn More & Join → ][134]

#### Fearless Wisdom: An Introduction to Dzogchen

***August 1, 2026***

The path of Dzogchen — the “Great Perfection” — reveals that the wisdom we seek is already within
us, hidden only by a subtle oversight. On August 1, Mingyur Rinpoche leads a **free webinar** to
launch a year-long transmission of instructions drawn from the Dzogchen text *The Heart Essence of
the Primordial Secret*. Join us to get a roadmap for this transformative year of study and practice
to discover fearless wisdom.

[ Register For Free → ][135]

### Tergar Events

Join Mingyur Rinpoche and Tergar guides for a selection of online and in-person events, from
science-based meditation conversations to ancient Buddhist wisdom.
* **Offered online and in-person**
* **30,000 registrations per year**
* **Translation into 6 languages**

[ Check Out Our Events ][136]

### Meditation Teacher Program

The Meditation Teacher Program offers a year of extensive online training for those passionate about
becoming teachers grounded in awareness, compassion, and wisdom. Under the guidance of Mingyur
Rinpoche, you will learn modern methods to teach timeless wisdom.

[ Learn more ][137]

### We can only do this together

Your generosity fuels our mission. As a nonprofit organization, we rely on donations for about
one-third of our total budget. Your support allows us to continue offering transformative meditation
programs and resources that help people cultivate peace within themselves and the world around them.

[ Donate now ][138]

### Explore more resources
* ## Monthly Teachings
  
  Mingyur Rinpoche’s monthly teachings cover a broad range of topics. Some address common questions
  about meditation practice and how to bring mindfulness into everyday life, while others concern
  important principles in the Buddhist tradition. Most are about 5 minutes long. Enjoy!
  
  [ Watch now ][139]
* ## Ahem… Where are the Results of My Practice?
  
  In today’s fast-paced world, when everything is at our fingertips, we may expect immediate
  responses and instant results in all areas of life–including our meditation practice.
  Check out the full article on our blog.
  
  [ Read our blog ][140]
* ## My Meditation Journey with Michael Imperioli
  
  Join renowned actor and meditation practitioner Michael Imperioli, who had achieved everything he
  desired but felt a lack of spiritual dimension in his life, prompting him to embark on a new
  journey. During this intimate and insightful conversation with Dr. Cortland Dahl, Michael shared
  his personal journey with meditation and navigating the challenges of modern life.
  
  [ Watch now ][141]
* ## Community Circle Session with Tim Olmsted
  
  The Community Circle sessions are part of your Joy of Living Online subscription and offer a
  unique experience of learning and connecting. The sessions create an open and relaxed environment
  where you can share your experiences and gain insights from the questions and perspectives of
  fellow meditators.
  
  [ Watch an excerpt ][142]

## Stay Connected

Join our mailing list to receive updates, latest news, learn about our offerings and all the
incredible events of Tergar.

## Experience Rinpoche’s Teachings

Learn how to use meditation to transform stressful situations and challenging emotions into support
for awareness. Access now for free the “Beyond Mindfulness” Webinar and experience Rinpoches
teachings. By registering for free now, you will have immediate access to this incredible webinar.

[ Register for Free ][143]

### From Foundational to Advanced Buddhist Practices

Tergar International provides online and in-person meditation programs to communities and
individuals around the world. Founded to promote the teachings of world-famous author and meditation
teacher Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche, our global network offers a range of both secular meditation
programs and Buddhist study courses to people of all levels and interests who are eager to learn
meditation, establish or deepen their practice, and enhance their quality of life.

Whether a curious beginner keen to experience the benefits of meditation or find a reputable
teacher, or an established Mahamudra or Dzogchen Buddhist practitioner, you’ll find what you’re
looking for at Tergar. With a staff of highly experienced guides, Tergar provides easy access to
online meditation classes, guided practice sessions, structured training programs, and in-person
meditation retreats for meditators at all levels — with Mingyur Rinpoche’s authentic teachings being
the heart and foundation of all of these programs.

From our free mobile meditation app and regular monthly teachings shared across our digital media
channels, to subscription study packages supported by live sessions with our teachers, we offer
inspiration and support for every step of your meditation journey.

### Meditation Programs to Realize Your Full Potential

With support from qualified guides who show you step by step how to relax your mind and cultivate
your innate loving-kindness and wisdom, as well as self-paced online learning courses that explore
the ancient wisdom of Tibetan Buddhism, Tergar has developed programs for all kinds of meditation
journeys. Our wide range of courses help with everything from navigating the chaos of modern life
and gaining a deeper understanding of the meaning of tantra to fully entering the path of the
bodhisattva, someone who vows to relieve the suffering of all beings.
