## The Tergar Meditation Community of Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche

## **Register Now:**
## 2026 Events with Mingyur Rinpoche

We are happy to share the full schedule for Tergar International’s online and in-person events with
Mingyur Rinpoche and Tergar Lamas in 2026! [**Registration is now open**][124]** for several
events.**

[ Full Schedule → ][125]

## You are perfect right now.

### Discover this for yourself:

Tergar offers a step-by-step path to well-being, welcoming both Buddhist and non-Buddhist
practitioners on a profound journey of self-discovery.

Choose the one that resonates with you:

Responsive Toggle Switch
Learn to Meditate
Explore Buddhism

### Vajrayana Online and the Path of Liberation

Vajrayana Online is Tergar’s platform for students to explore Buddhism, from the first steps of the
Buddhist path to more advanced stages of Vajrayana practice and the Path of Liberation – Mingyur
Rinpoche’s step-by-step training in Buddhist meditation. Enjoy courses, webinars, retreats and a
global community of meditators to support you on your journey of awakening.

[ Learn more ][126]
[ Get Started ][127]

### Joy of Living Path

Joy of Living is a path of meditation with simple practices to calm the mind, open the heart, and
awaken wisdom. It focuses on applying meditation in everyday life and can be practiced by people of
all faiths and cultures.

[ Learn more ][128]
[ Get Started ][129]

## Meditate Anytime, Anywhere

#### Our mission is to transform hearts and minds by making the ancient wisdom of meditation
#### accessible to the modern world.

#### [Learn More About Us][130]

## Mingyur Rinpoche

Yongey  Mingyur Rinpoche is a teacher, best-selling author, and the guiding teacher of the worldwide
Tergar Meditation Community. He possesses a rare ability to present the ancient wisdom of Tibet in a
fresh, engaging manner. His profound yet accessible teachings and playful sense of humor have
endeared him to students around the world. Most uniquely, Rinpoche’s teachings weave together his
own personal experiences with modern scientific research, relating both to the practice of
meditation.

[ Read full biography ][131]

## Find Your Tergar Community

**We grow together by practicing awareness, compassion, and wisdom in Tergar groups and communities
around the globe. We believe that the power of this practice has a ripple effect on the whole
world.**

[ Join Now ][132]

### Upcoming Offerings

#### The Primordial Secret: Dzogchen Teachings on Resting in the Natural State

***August 15–17, 2026***

In this opening retreat of Tergar’s new year-long Dzogchen transmission, Mingyur Rinpoche will
transmit the crucial first sections of the *Heart Essence of the Primordial Secret* instruction
manual.

[ Learn More & Register → ][133]

#### New Course: Voices of Dzogchen

***August 1–26, 2026***

Voices of Dzogchen offers live webinars with prominent Buddhist teachers who embody the Dzogchen
tradition: Mingyur Rinpoche, Erik Pema Kunsang, Richard Barron (Lama Chökyi Nyima), and Sangye
Khandro.

[ Learn More & Join → ][134]

#### Fearless Wisdom: An Introduction to Dzogchen

***August 1, 2026***

The path of Dzogchen — the “Great Perfection” — reveals that the wisdom we seek is already within
us, hidden only by a subtle oversight. On August 1, Mingyur Rinpoche leads a **free webinar** to
launch a year-long transmission of instructions drawn from the Dzogchen text *The Heart Essence of
the Primordial Secret*. Join us to get a roadmap for this transformative year of study and practice
to discover fearless wisdom.

[ Register For Free → ][135]

### Tergar Events

Join Mingyur Rinpoche and Tergar guides for a selection of online and in-person events, from
science-based meditation conversations to ancient Buddhist wisdom.
* **Offered online and in-person**
* **30,000 registrations per year**
* **Translation into 6 languages**

[ Check Out Our Events ][136]

### Meditation Teacher Program

The Meditation Teacher Program offers a year of extensive online training for those passionate about
becoming teachers grounded in awareness, compassion, and wisdom. Under the guidance of Mingyur
Rinpoche, you will learn modern methods to teach timeless wisdom.

[ Learn more ][137]

### We can only do this together

Your generosity fuels our mission. As a nonprofit organization, we rely on donations for about
one-third of our total budget. Your support allows us to continue offering transformative meditation
programs and resources that help people cultivate peace within themselves and the world around them.

[ Donate now ][138]

### Explore more resources
* ## Monthly Teachings
  
  Mingyur Rinpoche’s monthly teachings cover a broad range of topics. Some address common questions
  about meditation practice and how to bring mindfulness into everyday life, while others concern
  important principles in the Buddhist tradition. Most are about 5 minutes long. Enjoy!
  
  [ Watch now ][139]
* ## Ahem… Where are the Results of My Practice?
  
  In today’s fast-paced world, when everything is at our fingertips, we may expect immediate
  responses and instant results in all areas of life–including our meditation practice.
  Check out the full article on our blog.
  
  [ Read our blog ][140]
* ## My Meditation Journey with Michael Imperioli
  
  Join renowned actor and meditation practitioner Michael Imperioli, who had achieved everything he
  desired but felt a lack of spiritual dimension in his life, prompting him to embark on a new
  journey. During this intimate and insightful conversation with Dr. Cortland Dahl, Michael shared
  his personal journey with meditation and navigating the challenges of modern life.
  
  [ Watch now ][141]
* ## Community Circle Session with Tim Olmsted
  
  The Community Circle sessions are part of your Joy of Living Online subscription and offer a
  unique experience of learning and connecting. The sessions create an open and relaxed environment
  where you can share your experiences and gain insights from the questions and perspectives of
  fellow meditators.
  
  [ Watch an excerpt ][142]

## Stay Connected

Join our mailing list to receive updates, latest news, learn about our offerings and all the
incredible events of Tergar.

## Experience Rinpoche’s Teachings

Learn how to use meditation to transform stressful situations and challenging emotions into support
for awareness. Access now for free the “Beyond Mindfulness” Webinar and experience Rinpoches
teachings. By registering for free now, you will have immediate access to this incredible webinar.

[ Register for Free ][143]

### From Foundational to Advanced Buddhist Practices

Tergar International provides online and in-person meditation programs to communities and
individuals around the world. Founded to promote the teachings of world-famous author and meditation
teacher Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche, our global network offers a range of both secular meditation
programs and Buddhist study courses to people of all levels and interests who are eager to learn
meditation, establish or deepen their practice, and enhance their quality of life.

Whether a curious beginner keen to experience the benefits of meditation or find a reputable
teacher, or an established Mahamudra or Dzogchen Buddhist practitioner, you’ll find what you’re
looking for at Tergar. With a staff of highly experienced guides, Tergar provides easy access to
online meditation classes, guided practice sessions, structured training programs, and in-person
meditation retreats for meditators at all levels — with Mingyur Rinpoche’s authentic teachings being
the heart and foundation of all of these programs.

From our free mobile meditation app and regular monthly teachings shared across our digital media
channels, to subscription study packages supported by live sessions with our teachers, we offer
inspiration and support for every step of your meditation journey.

### Meditation Programs to Realize Your Full Potential

With support from qualified guides who show you step by step how to relax your mind and cultivate
your innate loving-kindness and wisdom, as well as self-paced online learning courses that explore
the ancient wisdom of Tibetan Buddhism, Tergar has developed programs for all kinds of meditation
journeys. Our wide range of courses help with everything from navigating the chaos of modern life
and gaining a deeper understanding of the meaning of tantra to fully entering the path of the
bodhisattva, someone who vows to relieve the suffering of all beings.

Why do I need a teacher? Can’t I learn this on my own?

TM is practiced sitting comfortably, with your eyes closed, for 20 minutes, twice a day. During the

automatically through the TM technique.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Why do I need a teacher? Can’t I learn this on my own?

Having a certified teacher guide you in a personal, one-on-one setting ensures: 
* You’re accurately and effectively learning the Transcendental Meditation technique
* You have the chance to talk through the new experiences that come up
* Establishes the foundation for a lifelong support system

How do you actually do TM? What happens during Transcendental Meditation?

TM is practiced sitting comfortably, with your eyes closed, for 20 minutes, twice a day. During the
practice, your mind naturally settles inward into quieter levels of awareness, without asking you to
concentrate or control anything. The result is pure consciousness—a unique state of deep rest that
helps the body and mind reset.

Is TM similar to other mantra meditations? What is a TM mantra?

Your Transcendental Meditation mantra is a specific sound chosen for you personally by your TM
Teacher. Unlike affirmations or other phrases rooted in meaning, your TM mantra isn’t meant to keep
your mind active or focused. Instead, it’s an important part of the technique that helps the mind
settle inward naturally and effortlessly.

What does “transcending” mean?

Scientists have studied what happens to the brain during Transcendental Meditation, and it’s called
“transcending”. It’s when your mind and body settle inward into a quiet, deeply restful state, while
you’re still fully awake. There’s no concentration or effort required on your part—it all happens
automatically through the TM technique. 

Throughout this process, the nervous system begins to reset, which is what leads to many of the
benefits people notice from TM, like less stress, clearer thinking, and greater overall balance. And
when you do this day after day, these benefits keep growing.

What if I'm not good at controlling my mind?

That’s completely okay, and actually very common. Especially because the Transcendental Meditation
technique doesn’t ask you to control your mind, nor does it require any concentration or effort. The
technique works naturally, even for people who feel like their mind never slows down.

What if I'm skeptical?

No worries, a lot of people are at first. The good news is Transcendental Meditation doesn’t depend
on any religion, philosophy, or belief system to work. In fact, you don’t need to change your
lifestyle at all. The technique works naturally by allowing the mind and nervous system to settle
into a deeply restful state, regardless of whether or not you have doubts.

Can beginners really do it?

Absolutely! Transcendental Meditation is designed to be effortless to learn and practice, even if
you’ve never meditated before. Children as young as 10 years old learn the technique successfully,
because transcending is something the mind naturally knows how to do.

Is it safe for anxiety, depression, or trauma?

Transcendental Meditation is a gentle, natural technique that helps regulate the nervous system and
create deep rest. Many therapists and healthcare professionals recommend it as a complement to other
forms of support and treatment, and it’s the only meditation practice ever referenced in American
Heart Association guidelines.

Can I do it anywhere?

Anywhere you can sit comfortably with your eyes closed, you can practice Transcendental Meditation.
People practice sitting up in bed, riding on the bus, on an airplane, or in a comfortable chair at
home. TM is designed to fit into your day, not interrupt it.

What happens during the 4-day course?

You’ll learn Transcendental Meditation over four sessions with a certified TM Teacher. The first is
a personal one-on-one instruction, followed by three guided sessions designed to deepen
understanding, ensure accuracy, and support your experience. Most people describe the learning
process as surprisingly easy, and many tell us they wish they’d started sooner.

What kind of follow-up support is there?

Your support doesn’t end after the course. You’ll continue to have the partnership of your
Transcendental Meditation Teacher for guidance, tune-ups, and questions whenever you have them.
Plus, you’ll have lifelong access to TM Centers worldwide, and ongoing daily resources through the
official TM app.

How do I learn? 

Learning Transcendental Meditation starts by enrolling in a course with a certified TM Teacher. In
your first session, you’ll receive personal one-on-one instruction. Then, you’ll join a small group
for the following three sessions, either in-person or virtually. During this time, you’ll learn
everything you need to know to maintain a self-sufficient TM practice, while also having our ongoing
support to help establish a practice that feels natural, sustainable, and easy to maintain.

Learn more about the TM Course here: [https://www.tm.org/transcendental-meditation-explained][31]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Why do I need a teacher? Can’t I learn this on my own?

Having a certified teacher guide you in a personal, one-on-one setting ensures: 
* You’re accurately and effectively learning the Transcendental Meditation technique
* You have the chance to talk through the new experiences that come up
* Establishes the foundation for a lifelong support system

How do you actually do TM? What happens during Transcendental Meditation?

TM is practiced sitting comfortably, with your eyes closed, for 20 minutes, twice a day. During the
practice, your mind naturally settles inward into quieter levels of awareness, without asking you to
concentrate or control anything. The result is pure consciousness—a unique state of deep rest that
helps the body and mind reset.

Is TM similar to other mantra meditations? What is a TM mantra?

Your Transcendental Meditation mantra is a specific sound chosen for you personally by your TM
Teacher. Unlike affirmations or other phrases rooted in meaning, your TM mantra isn’t meant to keep
your mind active or focused. Instead, it’s an important part of the technique that helps the mind
settle inward naturally and effortlessly.

What does “transcending” mean?

Scientists have studied what happens to the brain during Transcendental Meditation, and it’s called
“transcending”. It’s when your mind and body settle inward into a quiet, deeply restful state, while
you’re still fully awake. There’s no concentration or effort required on your part—it all happens
automatically through the TM technique. 

Throughout this process, the nervous system begins to reset, which is what leads to many of the
benefits people notice from TM, like less stress, clearer thinking, and greater overall balance. And
when you do this day after day, these benefits keep growing.

What if I'm not good at controlling my mind?

That’s completely okay, and actually very common. Especially because the Transcendental Meditation
technique doesn’t ask you to control your mind, nor does it require any concentration or effort. The
technique works naturally, even for people who feel like their mind never slows down.

What if I'm skeptical?

No worries, a lot of people are at first. The good news is Transcendental Meditation doesn’t depend
on any religion, philosophy, or belief system to work. In fact, you don’t need to change your
lifestyle at all. The technique works naturally by allowing the mind and nervous system to settle
into a deeply restful state, regardless of whether or not you have doubts.

Can beginners really do it?

Absolutely! Transcendental Meditation is designed to be effortless to learn and practice, even if
you’ve never meditated before. Children as young as 10 years old learn the technique successfully,
because transcending is something the mind naturally knows how to do.

Is it safe for anxiety, depression, or trauma?

Transcendental Meditation is a gentle, natural technique that helps regulate the nervous system and
create deep rest. Many therapists and healthcare professionals recommend it as a complement to other
forms of support and treatment, and it’s the only meditation practice ever referenced in American
Heart Association guidelines.

Can I do it anywhere?

Anywhere you can sit comfortably with your eyes closed, you can practice Transcendental Meditation.
People practice sitting up in bed, riding on the bus, on an airplane, or in a comfortable chair at
home. TM is designed to fit into your day, not interrupt it.

What happens during the 4-day course?

You’ll learn Transcendental Meditation over four sessions with a certified TM Teacher. The first is
a personal one-on-one instruction, followed by three guided sessions designed to deepen
understanding, ensure accuracy, and support your experience. Most people describe the learning
process as surprisingly easy, and many tell us they wish they’d started sooner.

What kind of follow-up support is there?

Your support doesn’t end after the course. You’ll continue to have the partnership of your
Transcendental Meditation Teacher for guidance, tune-ups, and questions whenever you have them.
Plus, you’ll have lifelong access to TM Centers worldwide, and ongoing daily resources through the
official TM app.

How do I learn? 

Learning Transcendental Meditation starts by enrolling in a course with a certified TM Teacher. In
your first session, you’ll receive personal one-on-one instruction. Then, you’ll join a small group
for the following three sessions, either in-person or virtually. During this time, you’ll learn
everything you need to know to maintain a self-sufficient TM practice, while also having our ongoing
support to help establish a practice that feels natural, sustainable, and easy to maintain.

Learn more about the TM Course here: [https://www.tm.org/transcendental-meditation-explained][31]

      [Home][1]
[Vipassana Fellowship - Calm and Insight meditation inspired by the early Buddhist tradition.]
Mindfulness meditation from the Theravada tradition for the spiritual development of people of all
faiths & none. [Online courses & support since 1997][2]
* [ Practical Training ][3]
* [ Meditation Resources][4]
* [ Buddhist Context ][5]
* [ Pali Canon ][6]
* [ Newsletter ][7]


#### Welcome to Vipassana Fellowship

"The Buddha taught Dhamma to his followers out of compassion, he taught them Dhamma for their
benefit and happiness. When they had listened to the Dhamma they could ponder over it and put it
into practice. The Buddha taught about the ill effects of anger. Anger leads to different kinds of
suffering for the person who is angry, but the person to whom anger is directed does not have to
suffer from it if he does not have anger himself."

- Khun Sujin Boriharnwanaket

#### [Meditation Course][8]

The online [meditation course][9] has been hosted here since 1997. Our 10 week course provides a
clear and practical introduction to tranquillity and insight practices originating in the Theravada
tradition of Buddhism but beneficial to all.

#### [Authentic Texts][10]

All of the documents on this site take their lead from the [Pali Canon][11]; the most authoritative
record and guide to the historical Buddha's teachings. They are part of a living spiritual tradition
that continues to flourish after two and a half millennia. These documents provide contextual
background for our meditation practice.

#### [Useful Resources][12]

We are an independent site promoting a balanced approach to the practice of meditation. We aim to
offer [resources][13] to help nurture and sustain a fulfilling and effective meditation practice.

#### [Authoritative Teachings][14]

In addition to presenting the core texts of early Buddhism we are developing an online library
featuring some of the finest modern writing on [meditation][15].

#### [Stay Informed][16]

Our [newsletter][17] contains details of our new courses and items of interest to those meditating
in the vipassana and samatha traditions.

What is vipassana?

In the Pali language of the early Buddhist texts, vipassana means insight. It is often used to
describe one of the two main categories of Buddhist meditation (the other being samatha or
tranquillity).

What is Theravada Buddhism?

The southern form of Buddhism now found mainly in Thailand, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar. It is the oldest
living tradition and its core teachings are based on the word of the Buddha as found in the earliest
texts.

Are your courses only for Buddhists?

Definitely not! Most of our participants are not Buddhist. We always have a wide range of people of
many different faiths (and of no faith) on our courses. We explain the context in which these
particular meditation practices developed but our aim is to help people to learn to meditate, in a
clear and systematic way, to see if it is useful in their lives - whatever their existing beliefs.

Dhamma Essay:
[The Meditative Mind by Ayya Khema][18]

      [Home][1]
[Vipassana Fellowship - Calm and Insight meditation inspired by the early Buddhist tradition.]
Mindfulness meditation from the Theravada tradition for the spiritual development of people of all
faiths & none. [Online courses & support since 1997][2]
* [ Practical Training ][3]
* [ Meditation Resources][4]
* [ Buddhist Context ][5]
* [ Pali Canon ][6]
* [ Newsletter ][7]


#### Welcome to Vipassana Fellowship

"The Buddha taught Dhamma to his followers out of compassion, he taught them Dhamma for their
benefit and happiness. When they had listened to the Dhamma they could ponder over it and put it
into practice. The Buddha taught about the ill effects of anger. Anger leads to different kinds of
suffering for the person who is angry, but the person to whom anger is directed does not have to
suffer from it if he does not have anger himself."

- Khun Sujin Boriharnwanaket

#### [Meditation Course][8]

The online [meditation course][9] has been hosted here since 1997. Our 10 week course provides a
clear and practical introduction to tranquillity and insight practices originating in the Theravada
tradition of Buddhism but beneficial to all.

#### [Authentic Texts][10]

All of the documents on this site take their lead from the [Pali Canon][11]; the most authoritative
record and guide to the historical Buddha's teachings. They are part of a living spiritual tradition
that continues to flourish after two and a half millennia. These documents provide contextual
background for our meditation practice.

#### [Useful Resources][12]

We are an independent site promoting a balanced approach to the practice of meditation. We aim to
offer [resources][13] to help nurture and sustain a fulfilling and effective meditation practice.

#### [Authoritative Teachings][14]

In addition to presenting the core texts of early Buddhism we are developing an online library
featuring some of the finest modern writing on [meditation][15].

#### [Stay Informed][16]

Our [newsletter][17] contains details of our new courses and items of interest to those meditating
in the vipassana and samatha traditions.

What is vipassana?

In the Pali language of the early Buddhist texts, vipassana means insight. It is often used to
describe one of the two main categories of Buddhist meditation (the other being samatha or
tranquillity).

What is Theravada Buddhism?

The southern form of Buddhism now found mainly in Thailand, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar. It is the oldest
living tradition and its core teachings are based on the word of the Buddha as found in the earliest
texts.

Are your courses only for Buddhists?

Definitely not! Most of our participants are not Buddhist. We always have a wide range of people of
many different faiths (and of no faith) on our courses. We explain the context in which these
particular meditation practices developed but our aim is to help people to learn to meditate, in a
clear and systematic way, to see if it is useful in their lives - whatever their existing beliefs.

Dhamma Essay:
[The Meditative Mind by Ayya Khema][18]

Imagine a life free from pain and sorrow, and infused with joy and tranquility.

The ancient yogis called this state vishoka and insisted that we all can reach it. The key is a
precise set of meditative techniques designed to unite the mind and breath and turn them inward.

Meditation is the perfect complement to your existing yoga practice, as well as a powerful

[Pandit Rajmani Tigunait, Himalayan Institute Spiritual Head]

Vishoka Meditation is grounded in the authentic wisdom of ancient, yet living, tradition embodied by
luminaries including Buddha, Patanjali, and a long line of Siddha masters. Drawing upon both yoga
and tantra, Vishoka Meditation shares the essence of ancient source texts including the Yoga Sutra,
Lotus Sutra, and Shiva Sutra.

Passed down for thousands of years, the practice of Vishoka Meditation was distilled for the
21st-century practitioner by Pandit Rajmani Tigunait, Ph.D., a modern-day master and spiritual head
of the Himalayan Institute.

### Pandit Rajmani Tigunait, PhD

Spiritual Head at Himalayan Institue

Pandit Rajmani Tigunait, Ph.D., is a modern-day master and living link in the unbroken Himalayan
Tradition. He is the successor to Sri Swami Rama of the Himalayas, and the spiritual head of the
Himalayan Institute. As the author of numerous books, including his autobiography Touched by Fire:
The Ongoing Journey of a Spiritual Seeker, Pandit Tigunait offers practical guidance on applying
yogic and tantric wisdom to modern life. For over 40 years he has touched innumerable lives around
the world as a teacher, humanitarian, and visionary spiritual leader. You can view more of his
teachings online at the Himalayan Institute Wisdom Library.

Pandit Tigunait holds two doctorates: one in Sanskrit from the University of Allahabad in India, and
another in Oriental Studies from the University of Pennsylvania. Family tradition gave Pandit
Tigunait access to a vast range of spiritual wisdom preserved in both the written and oral
traditions. Before meeting his master, Pandit Tigunait studied Sanskrit, the language of the ancient
scriptures of India, as well as the languages of the Buddhist, Jaina, and Zorastrian traditions. In
1976, Swami Rama ordained Pandit Tigunait into the 5,000-year-old lineage of the Himalayan Masters.

# THE SIGNAL IN THE NOISE

Water & Music is the go-to research partner for music companies exploring new technologies, business
models, and futures.

We cut through the hype to show you what actually matters in music tech. While others chase
headlines, we dig deeper — mapping real opportunities, spotting patterns across the industry, and
helping you make smarter decisions about partnerships, products, and positioning.

# Built on a foundation of trust

From 2019–2025, our paid membership welcomed 5,000 music industry leaders through our doors.
Together, we:
* Put music tech on the map as a serious $15B+ industry
* Spotted AI, Web3, and gaming trends months before they went mainstream
* Connected co-founders who went on to raise millions in capital
* Built the most trusted network of music tech innovators globally

Today, we're making our past six years of knowledge free, while focusing on cultivating deeper
partnerships with companies ready to lead — not follow — in the next wave of technological change.

Welcome to

# Wat Pa Tam Wua

A beautiful and peaceful Buddhist Forest Monastery open to everyone.

## Plan a meditation retreat at Wat Pa Tam Wua

Wat Pa Tam Wua is a Theravada Buddhist Forest Monastery in Mae Hong Son, Northern Thailand. People
of every background are welcome to learn Buddhist practice in a peaceful monastic setting. Start
with our [**complete meditation retreat in Thailand guide**][24] for an honest overview of the stay.

### No booking

Walk in any day of the year and check in between 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM.

### Stay 3–10 days

Three days is the recommended minimum; ten days is the usual maximum.

### Offered freely

Accommodation, bedding, white clothes and vegetarian meals are provided without charge. Donations
are welcome.

### Monastic practice

Guests follow the daily timetable, attend required sessions and observe the monastery rules.

This is a working Buddhist monastery, not a hotel or wellness resort. Please read the practical
information before travelling and arrive prepared to participate fully.

[Read the retreat guide][25][Plan your journey][26][View the timetable][27]

## Video about Wat Pa Tam Wua:

[Watch video about Wat Pa Tam Wua]Load video on click
[Explore the meditation programme][28]

## Wat Pa Tam Wua Books

### "Walk to be the Knower"

Want to learn more about Buddha, Dharma, Vipassana meditation and our monastery?

Welcome to download the online book written by Phra Anek Thanissarapoti, one of the monks of Wat Pa
Tam Wua! This book is a great source of knowledge, it includes:
* Life of the Buddha
* What did the Buddha teach
* Handbook of Vipassana
* About Wat Tam Wua Forest Monastery

[Download Book][29]
[Walk to be the Knower — book by Phra Anek Thanissarapoti]
[Mantras Chanting Book — Wat Pa Tam Wua]

### Mantras Chanting Book

In this Chanting Book, first we talk about some of the essentials: Buddha, Dhamma and Sangha.

Then we explain one of the Mindfulness techniques we actively using in our monastery: "Practice
Mindfulness in bow down three times".

You will also find all the chantings that we practice at Wat Pa Tam Wua every evening. We always
chant in three languages: Pali, Thai and English.

[Download Chanting Book][30]
[Welcome to Wat Pa Tam Wua Forest Monastery]

# Welcome


With mindful presence, extraordinary potential is revealed. We guide stressed minds to centered
success, elevating fulfillment across all life domains.

[Learn More][17]

###### Discover your hidden potential through our welcoming approach to time-honored meditation
###### traditions.

###### We guide you towards personal transformation and serenity, supported by science-backed
###### benefits of a consistent practice.

Meditation isn't just a practice—it's a powerful tool for transformation. Research shows that
regular meditation can:
* Lower blood pressure and heart rate
* Strengthen your immune system
* Increase gray matter in your brain
* Reduce symptoms of depression and anxiety
* Improve sleep quality
* Regulate and balance your emotions
* Enhance creativity and problem-solving skills


Experience these benefits firsthand at The Well Mind Collective. Our expert-guided sessions are
designed to help you harness the full potential of meditation, backed by years of scientific
research.

Community: The Heart of Healing

At the Well Mind Collective, we understand that true well-being flourishes in connection. That's why
we've cultivated a warm, supportive community central to our practice. Studies show that social
connection is crucial for mental health and healing. Here, you'll find:
* A welcoming, judgment-free space
* Opportunities to connect with like-minded individuals
* Group sessions that foster a sense of belonging
* Support in your personal growth journey


Join us to experience the harmony of mindfulness and community. Together, we'll nurture both
individual and collective well-being.

Invest in your health and happiness today. Your mind, body, and spirit will thank you.

[five black rocks]
[five black rocks]

Discover your potential through meditation and mindfulness for a serene, balanced life.

Why does **Wholesalers Network** offer this directory of wholesale companies for free?
We’re glad you asked. We understand that starting and running a business is hard work. It costs a

challenging it can be to find the right wholesaler.

## Wholesale sourcing and the evolving digital marketplace

Platforms like Wholesalers Network provide businesses with structured access to thousands of
suppliers across multiple categories, making it easier to discover products for both online and
offline sales. Such directories play an important role in the B2B ecosystem by helping entrepreneurs
and retailers connect with manufacturers, distributors, and dropshipping partners in a more
efficient way.

In wholesale commerce, success depends heavily on reliable sourcing, consistent supply chains, and
strong supplier relationships. Businesses that take the time to evaluate partners, compare pricing
structures, and test product quality are better positioned to scale sustainably and maintain healthy
profit margins over time.

For a deeper look at how buyers can verify credibility before they commit money or time, read [Trust
Signals in B2B Wholesale Sourcing vs New Online Casinos][144].

Within this broader ecosystem, platforms such as **[casinoer uden rofus][145]** reflect how diverse
online experiences have become, offering users additional ways to engage and relax during their free
time.

As the digital marketplace continues to expand, B2B platforms are becoming more than just
directories—they are evolving into ecosystems where information, logistics, and communication
intersect. This transformation allows businesses to operate more efficiently and adapt to changing
market demands with greater flexibility.

At the same time, the online environment is not limited to business and sourcing alone. Users
interact with a wide variety of platforms daily, combining work-related activities with
entertainment and leisure in a single digital space.

Ultimately, building a successful wholesale business requires a combination of smart sourcing
strategies, adaptability, and balance. By leveraging reliable directories while staying open to
broader digital trends, businesses can create sustainable growth in an increasingly connected world.

Do you list [wholesale dropship companies][146] on this website?
Yes. All companies that offer drop shipping are linked to the “[Dropshipper][147]” page of the
directory. See our article on dropshipping or eBay wholesalers for more information.

We also list wholesale distributors, manufacturers of products, trade only, end of line and closeout
merchandise, liquidators, distribution networks, b2b news, wholesale suppliers, importers,
exporters, transport, and logistics companies.

As digital markets continue to evolve, many businesses are looking beyond traditional wholesale and
retail models to identify new growth opportunities. The expansion of online ecosystems has created
entirely new sectors where partnerships, scalability, and global reach are essential components of
success.

In addition to physical goods and logistics networks, digital platforms now play a significant role
in shaping modern commerce. From subscription-based services to entertainment-driven platforms, the
structure of these industries often mirrors wholesale principles — connecting suppliers with end
users through efficient and scalable systems.

A notable example of this shift can be seen in the growth of international online entertainment
platforms. Concepts such as **[Online Casino utan spelpaus][148]** highlight how digital services
are expanding across borders, offering users alternative experiences while relying on strong backend
infrastructure, marketing strategies, and user acquisition models.

For entrepreneurs and business owners, understanding these parallel industries can provide valuable
insights into customer behavior, digital scaling strategies, and emerging global trends. Exploring
how different sectors operate can ultimately help businesses remain competitive and adaptable in an
increasingly interconnected marketplace.

### Employee wellness for the modern workplace:
### Mindfulness training & workshops; yoga, meditation & stretch classes.

Work From Om® supports forward-thinking employers by bringing the benefits of mindfulness,
meditation, yoga and community to workplaces of all shapes and sizes.

Our programs help people build healthy habits that stretch the body and the mind, because **we know
that people who prioritize well-being will feel and perform better. **

## Work From Om® With Us

### Customized Memberships: Ongoing Mindfulness and Movement Programming

A Work From Om® Membership offers a complete employee wellness solution for the remote-friendly
workplace through yoga, meditation and mindfulness programming that is both engaging and effective.
Each membership is customized with a class program just for your employees, on a schedule that works
for your company. Plus perks!

**Monthly billing. No minimum commitment. Cancel any time. **

[ [Workplace Yoga Image.jpg] ][26]
[ Memberships ][27]

### Mindfulness Workshops & Professional Development Seminars

Say hello to aha!-moments with Work From Om® workshops and professional development seminars, which
are as educational as they are experiential. Utilizing mindfulness for the advancement of soft
skills, emotional intelligence and overall well-being, we'll help your team be healthy, happy and
high-functioning in 2021 and beyond.

[ [Workplace Workshops Image.jpg] ][28]
[ Workshops ][29]

## Our Classes

#### Our [Signature Guided Sessions][30] are the building blocks of every Work From Om® Membership.

## Contact us today.

**For pricing, consultation and scheduling. Get started for just $99.**

[ Inquiry Form ][31]

**Takes less than two minutes.
**Answer a few form questions and we’ll be in touch with information and options.

[ Email Us ][32]

**Start the conversation.
**Let us know what questions you need answered; we’ll reply with how we can help.

[ Schedule A Call ][33]

**Pick a time that works for you.
**Schedule a 15-30 minute call with a programming specialist at your convenience.

## It really works. Just ask our clients.

[AIG Logo Transparent (1).png]

“It was great to be a part of the **social experience** – some of my friends and I sent private
messages saying hi to each other right before it started. This is so needed and so refreshing given
the situation we are all in. The routine and the amount of time were also perfect for a WFH day. **I
would do this nearly every day** if I could.

— Dan, SVP

[omnicom logo.png]

“Since I have been **working from home**, I find that I do not get up and walk around or stretch
often, so by the end of the work day, I am stiff. These [Work From Om®"] workshops help **keep your
blood flowing**!”

— Diedre, Supervisor

[Flatiron+Health+Logo.png]

“I've attended some Stretch & Refresh sessions which have been wonderful experiences to break up the
work day. The sessions **do not require any prior experience or level of flexibility**. I highly
recommend Work from Om® as a way to promote relaxation and refresh employees to **get back to work
more productively**.”

— Lindsey, Supervisor

unique offerings, combining many new modalities in the meditation, yoga, sound healing, breathwork,

tantric meditation.

**People** come from all over the world to discover themselves and their potential under the best

# directly from the Source

**A yoga retreat **at Håå Retreat Center in southern Sweden is unique in content and intensity. We
have extensive experience conducting deep retreats.

**Our programmes** are designed for those who want to experience the strength and depth of yoga and
tantric meditation.

**People** come from all over the world to discover themselves and their potential under the best
possible circumstances.

## Newsletter Signup

Receive updates and inspiration from Håå Retreat Center:


**Håå Retreat Center**, located in the south of Sweden, is part of the nonprofit Scandinavian Yoga
and Meditation School.

Since 1972, we have welcomed people from around the world seeking to discover more about themselves
through yoga and meditation, from complete beginners to experienced practitioners.

A full-time training of at least four years gives our teachers a strong foundation for sharing the
yoga tradition in its original form.
